raw.description:
ProperExpression | Full-Time | Fully Remote

About ProperExpression

ProperExpression is a fully remote growth marketing agency specializing in the wealth management ecosystem - RIAs, independent broker-dealers, and WealthTech companies. RevOps is one of our five core service pillars, and our clients trust us to run their revenue infrastructure end to end, from CRM architecture to marketing automation to full-funnel reporting.We're a HubSpot Platinum partner, and HubSpot is the center of gravity for most of our client work. But our clients increasingly live in both worlds, and we're expanding into more Salesforce integration work. That's where you come in.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior RevOps Solutions Architect who can straddle the HubSpot and Salesforce worlds with equal comfort. You'll design complex integration solutions and get hands-on building them - this is not a whiteboard-only architect role, and it's not a ticket-taking admin role either.You'll join client calls as the technical authority in the room: running discovery, walking through solution designs, training client teams, and answering the hard questions. Our account team owns the overall client relationship, so you can focus on what you do best.If you've built the HubSpot-Salesforce integration more times than you can count, you've guided developers through custom API work without writing the code yourself, and you're equally at home in Marketing Hub and Marketing Cloud, this role was written for you.

What You'll Do

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex HubSpot instances: CRM structure, marketing automation, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, custom objects, workflows, and reporting
  • Build complex reporting that goes beyond a dashboard: spot data issues before we have to find them, QA reports because you understand the client's business, and flag what additional analysis needs digging into so our Account Strategists and Account Directors can pick it up from there
  • Design and execute HubSpot-Salesforce integrations end to end: field mapping, sync logic, deduplication, and troubleshooting sync errors in production environments
  • Lead custom API integrations: scope the solution, define the architecture and data flows, and guide developers through implementation. You won't write production code, but you'll own the design and be the person devs come to with questions
  • Handle integrations beyond the native connector: middleware (Zapier, Make, Workato), APIs, and third-party tools across the client's stack
  • Build marketing automation programs in both HubSpot Marketing Hub and Salesforce Marketing Cloud: nurture sequences, campaign infrastructure, attribution
  • Join client calls as the technical lead: discovery and scoping sessions, solution walkthroughs, trainings, and troubleshooting conversations, while our account team owns the day-to-day relationship
  • Audit client portals and tech stacks, diagnose problems, and present clear recommendations
  • Support account consolidations, portal migrations, and multi-system integrations during M&A activity, rebrands, or restructures
  • Collaborate with our strategy, content, and paid media teams so RevOps work supports the full engagement
  • Manage and QA the work of our HubSpot specialist, reviewing builds, workflows, and reporting before they reach the client

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on RevOps, marketing ops, or CRM architecture experience
  • Deep, expert-level HubSpot experience across Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and Operations Hub. You should be the person others come to with HubSpot questions
  • Strong Salesforce proficiency: objects, fields, flows, permissions, and reporting. You can hold your own in a Salesforce org without hand-holding
  • Proven, repeated experience building and maintaining the HubSpot-Salesforce integration in production, plus other integrations across the RevOps stack
  • Experience leading custom API integrations: you can read API documentation, design the data architecture, and direct developers, even though you're not the one writing code
  • Working experience with both HubSpot Marketing Hub and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Confident client-facing communication: you can run the technical portion of a call, explain your decisions in business language, and push back when needed
  • Comfortable managing multiple client engagements at an agency pace
  • HubSpot certifications strongly preferred; Salesforce Admin certification a plus

Big Bonus

  • Experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC). Our clients are RIAs, broker-dealers, and WealthTechs, so FSC experience puts you at the front of the line

You're Probably a Fit If

  • HubSpot is your home base, but you're just as comfortable in a Salesforce org
  • You've untangled a broken HubSpot-Salesforce sync more than once and know where the bodies are buried
  • You like designing the solution AND building it - you don't consider hands-on work beneath you, and you don't hide from architecture decisions either
  • You've sat between business stakeholders and developers on an API integration and translated fluently in both directions
  • You've worked in an agency or consultancy, or supported multiple business units, and know how to context-switch

You're Probably Not a Fit If

  • Your HubSpot experience is limited to sending emails and building basic workflows
  • You've only ever touched Salesforce through a sync you didn't set up
  • You want to design solutions but hand off all the execution, or execute specs without owning the design
  • You prefer to work behind the scenes and avoid client calls entirely
  • You need detailed instructions before starting a project

Why ProperExpression

  • Fully remote team of ~25 with a strong operating rhythm
  • Deep specialization in a growing niche (wealth management and WealthTech)
  • HubSpot Platinum partnership with direct access to partner resources, and a real opportunity to shape our expanding Salesforce practice
  • Senior-level autonomy: you own your solutions and your technical decisions
  • Competitive compensation based on experience

Application Instructions

Please read and follow the application instructions to ensure your application is considered.

1. Please submit your resume in PDF format.

2. Please indicate what your favorite food is and why in the Additional Comments field.

3. Please don't email or send us a LinkedIn message until we've reached out to you.

4. If we do schedule an intro call, don't forget to ask your interviewer about how a bison became the mascot and spirit animal for ProperExpression.

raw.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
raw.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

Tu es la première voix que les prospects entendent — et la première impression qui conditionne chaque deal. En tant que Représentant.e en développement des ventes chez ShareGate, ton rôle est de démarrer des conversations avec les bons acheteurs TI, qu'ils aient levé la main ou non, et de transmettre aux AE exactement ce qu'il leur faut pour gagner. Tu travailleras avec ton propre agent IA, qui gère les lots de prospection sortante et les leads faciles à convertir, pendant que tu te concentres sur les appels, les comptes à forte valeur et le travail manuel qui demande un humain. Ce rôle existe parce qu'on grandit, parce qu'on promeut de l'intérieur, et parce qu'on cherche quelqu'un qui veut bâtir une vraie carrière en ventes B2B avec une équipe qui investit réellement dans ta progression.

Ton impact:

  • Alimenter le pipeline de l'équipe AE en démarrant des conversations avec des acheteurs TI, par la prospection sortante et le suivi des leads entrants — avec un volume constant et une qualité qui fait la différence au moment du handoff ;
  • Mener chaque qualification avec une approche consultative : comprendre la réalité du prospect, son défi et son niveau de maturité avant d'avancer, de sorte que chaque lead transféré est réellement prêt ;
  • Générer du pipeline sortant en ciblant des comptes, en rejoignant plusieurs interlocuteurs au sein des équipes TI et en menant des séquences et des appels qui créent de vraies conversations ;
  • Gérer et améliorer ton propre agent IA, qui s'occupe des lots de prospection sortante et des leads faciles à convertir, pour que tu puisses te concentrer sur les appels, les comptes à forte valeur et le travail manuel qui demande un humain ;
  • Devenir rapidement expert.e des deux produits ShareGate (Protect et Migrate) et des personas IT qu'on sert, pour que chaque conversation soit ancrée dans une connaissance produit réelle et non dans un script générique ;
  • Bâtir et améliorer des systèmes IA pour ton quotidien (prompts, assistants personnalisés, automatisations pour la préparation d'appels, la recherche de comptes et les suivis) et partager ce qui fonctionne pour faire progresser toute l'équipe ;
  • Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue des processus de l'équipe en apportant de nouvelles idées, surtout autour de l'IA, pour qu'on reste toujours en avance.

Ton équipe

Tu rejoins une équipe de quatre SDR, tous focalisés sur ShareGate, avec un objectif commun : alimenter l'équipe AE avec du pipeline de qualité. Ici, la qualité de ce que tu transmets compte autant que le volume. L'équipe est coachée de près : revues d'appels sur Gong, sessions de roleplay, outils IA sur mesure, et un gestionnaire dont la job est de te faire grandir. On avance vite, on partage ce qui fonctionne et on se tient collectivement à un standard élevé.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français ;
  • Utilisateur.rice d'outils IA (Claude, ChatGPT, ou équivalent) au quotidien dans ton travail — pas par curiosité, par habitude — et capable d'adopter rapidement de nouveaux outils ;
  • Communication verbale solide en anglais — à l'aise au téléphone et en vidéo, avec une présence qui crée une première impression mémorable ;
  • Expérience en ventes (SDR, BDR, ventes internes) ou dans un rôle orienté performance avec des cibles claires à atteindre ;
  • Expérience en prospection sortante (appels à froid, séquences multi-touch) et la résilience qui vient avec ;
  • Capacité démontrée à comprendre rapidement des produits complexes et les besoins des acheteurs dans un contexte B2B ;
  • Rigueur dans la gestion du pipeline : tu sais prioriser, suivre et faire avancer plusieurs conversations en parallèle sans rien laisser tomber ;
  • Atout : expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou tech, familiarité avec Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator ou HubSpot, capacité à communiquer en français, et exemples de flux de travail ou d'outils IA que tu as bâtis toi-même.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 55k$ - 60k$ / OTE : 85k$ – 90k$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Data Analyst (Snowflake / SQL)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst (Snowflake / SQL) to support data analysis, data profiling, lineage validation, reporting, and regulatory data initiatives. The role will involve working with large and complex datasets in Snowflake, analyzing source-to-target data flows, validating report and data lineage, identifying data quality issues, and supporting the onboarding and maintenance of regulatory reports.

The ideal candidate should have strong SQL and data analysis capabilities, a good understanding of data flows and lineage, and the ability to work with both business and technical stakeholders to investigate data issues and translate reporting requirements into actionable data requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze data across source systems, transformation layers, data warehouses, and reporting platforms using advanced SQL.

  • Perform data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and exploratory analysis to understand data structures, relationships, completeness, and quality.

  • Analyze and validate source-to-target mappings, ensuring that data is correctly mapped through different stages of the data flow.

  • Validate report-to-source lineage, including the flow of data from source systems through transformations to final reports.

  • Trace data elements across systems to support impact analysis, issue investigation, and regulatory reporting requirements.

  • Support the onboarding of new regulatory reports by analyzing data requirements, source systems, mappings, transformations, and reporting logic.

  • Review existing reports and data flows to identify lineage gaps, inconsistencies, or undocumented transformations.

  • Perform data quality assessments and investigate issues related to completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and validity.

  • Conduct root cause analysis for data and reporting issues and work with technology and business teams to identify appropriate remediation.

  • Develop SQL queries and analytical outputs to support data investigations, reporting requirements, and governance activities.

  • Create and maintain analytical metrics, operational reports, and dashboards to communicate data quality and reporting outcomes.

  • Support audit, risk, compliance, and regulatory reporting activities, including data validation and evidence preparation.

  • Interpret business requirements, reporting specifications, and BRDs and translate them into data and analytical requirements.

  • Work closely with Data Analysts, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Governance teams, Report Owners, and business stakeholders.

  • Document data findings, mappings, lineage, business rules, analytical logic, and issue-resolution outcomes.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of data analysis, reporting, and data quality processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex joins, subqueries, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and data validation queries.

  • Experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.

  • Strong experience in data analysis and data profiling.

  • Understanding of data lineage, data flows, source-to-target mappings, and data transformations.

  • Experience investigating data quality issues and performing root cause analysis.

  • Ability to analyze large datasets andidentifypatterns, anomalies, inconsistencies, and data gaps.

  • Experience working with business and technical requirements and interpreting BRDs, reporting specifications, and data requirements.

  • Good understanding of reporting and data processes within enterprise environments.

raw.excerpt: About EdgeUnoEdgeUno is a US-based technology infrastructure company headquartered in Miami, with a strong operational presence across Latin America, including Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, Peru, and Ecuador.
raw.description:
About EdgeUno

EdgeUno is a US-based technology infrastructure company headquartered in Miami, with a strong operational presence across Latin America, including Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, Peru, and Ecuador. We enable digital businesses to scale with high performance and reliability by providing connectivity, IP Transit, private networks, data centers, bare metal, and cloud solutions to ISPs, hyperscalers, content providers, and global technology companies.

Through our own infrastructure platform and strategic interconnection with major global hubs, we deliver low latency, security, and operational resilience across the Americas and beyond.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to join our team in Mexico, focused on generating new business, opening new accounts, developing commercial opportunities, and selling EdgeUno’s wholesale telecommunications, connectivity, and digital infrastructure solutions in the Mexican market.

This is a hunter role, focused primarily on active prospecting, market mapping, building a pipeline from scratch, accessing new customers, opening strategic accounts, and closing new business.

The role requires direct sales experience within the wholesale telecommunications ecosystem, with a strong focus on ISPs, Internet Service Providers, and experience selling solutions such as IP Transit, backbone connectivity, EPL, Wave, DDoS mitigation, and related wholesale connectivity services.

We are not looking for a generic sales profile or someone focused primarily on maintaining an existing customer portfolio. The person must already come from the connectivity, carrier, ISP, telecom operator, or digital infrastructure market, ideally with hands-on experience selling to ISP decision-makers such as owners, technical directors, NOC managers, commercial leaders, and network executives.

The ideal candidate should have a strong hunter profile and growth mindset, with proven ability to prospect actively, identify new market opportunities, open doors, generate pipeline, manage negotiations, and close complex commercial opportunities.

This person should be commercially independent, disciplined, persistent, and comfortable creating opportunities instead of waiting for inbound leads. The candidate should also be able to adjust the commercial approach when needed and work closely with internal teams to deliver solutions aligned with customers’ technical and business requirements.

Core Responsibilities

Business Development and Prospecting

  • Focus primarily on ISPs as the core customer segment, building relationships with decision-makers at small, mid-sized, and large ISPs across Mexico.
  • Actively prospect new customers, map the market, open strategic accounts, generate new commercial conversations, and build a sales pipeline from scratch.
  • Develop new business opportunities with ISPs, carriers, telecom operators, enterprise customers, technology companies, data centers, resellers, content providers, and other buyers of connectivity and digital infrastructure solutions.
  • Use existing relationships within the Mexican telecommunications and ISP ecosystem to access decision-makers, identify commercial opportunities, and accelerate new business generation.
  • Generate, manage, and develop a strong sales pipeline, from initial prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and deal closure.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold and warm outreach, referrals, industry events, existing market relationships, and direct engagement with potential customers.

New Business and Customer Development

  • Build long-term commercial relationships with new customers, acting as the main commercial point of contact throughout the sales process and during the initial stages of account development.
  • Maintain consistent commercial follow-up with prospects and customers, ensuring timely responses, clear communication, and proper coordination with internal teams.
  • Understand each customer’s business model, network structure, growth plans, technical challenges, and connectivity requirements.
  • Support customer issue resolution when needed, coordinating with internal teams to protect commercial relationships and future growth opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the relationship after the initial sale by introducing additional services aligned with the customer’s needs.

Solution Selling and Commercial Execution

  • Sell wholesale telecommunications and digital infrastructure solutions, including IP Transit, backbone connectivity, EPL, Ethernet Private Line, Wave, DDoS mitigation, and related services.
  • Identify customers’ technical and commercial needs and position EdgeUno’s portfolio through a consultative sales approach.
  • Translate customer challenges into clear commercial opportunities and coordinate with technical teams to develop appropriate solutions.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, prepare proposals, manage objections, and lead the full sales cycle through closing.
  • Maintain ownership of opportunities and ensure consistent progress across every stage of the sales process.

Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams to ensure that proposed solutions are commercially viable, technically executable, and properly delivered.
  • Coordinate internal resources during the sales process and communicate customer requirements clearly to all stakeholders.
  • Provide internal teams with relevant market feedback, customer insights, and competitive information.

CRM, Market Intelligence and Growth

  • Track prospecting activities, sales goals, pipeline progress, customer interactions, and opportunity status accurately in the CRM system.
  • Maintain an organized and updated pipeline, including next steps, expected closing dates, commercial values, and identified risks.
  • Monitor telecommunications trends, customer needs, regulatory developments, infrastructure investments, and competitive dynamics in Mexico.
  • Identify new markets, customer segments, partnerships, and commercial opportunities that could support EdgeUno’s growth in the country.
  • Represent EdgeUno at industry events, meetings, conferences, and commercial networking opportunities when required.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • Proven sales experience in wholesale telecommunications, connectivity, carrier, ISP, telecom operator, or digital infrastructure markets.
  • Experience selling solutions such as IP Transit, backbone connectivity, EPL, Wave, DDoS mitigation, or related wholesale connectivity services.
  • Strong hunter profile, with experience prospecting new customers, opening accounts, building pipeline from scratch, and closing new business.
  • Solid knowledge of the Mexican ISP and telecommunications market, including its main players, commercial dynamics, and customer needs.
  • Experience selling directly to ISP decision-makers, such as owners, technical directors, NOC managers, and commercial leaders.
  • Ability to manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, organization, and CRM management skills.

Nice to Have

  • English proficiency.
  • Experience working with regional or international telecommunications companies.
  • Experience representing companies at telecommunications events, industry conferences, and commercial networking activities.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus a commission structure tied to individual performance.
  • Opportunity to contribute directly to EdgeUno’s commercial growth in Mexico.
  • Exposure to regional projects and customers across Latin America.
  • Career development, training, and growth opportunities within the company.
  • A collaborative, multicultural, and execution-focused environment where individual results have a visible impact.

Job Summary:

The Engineering Applications Lead is responsible for the operational ownership and lifecycle management of the firm’s engineering application portfolio, ensuring platforms are stable, supported, appropriately versioned, and aligned to business and project delivery needs. This role leads and participates in the coordination of support, upgrades, issue resolution, and continuous improvement activities across engineering tools, working closely with Engineering leadership, enterprise application teams, vendors, and other specialized technical partners. raw.description:
Since 2011, General Assembly has transformed tens of thousands of careers through pioneering, experiential education in today’s most in-demand skills. As featured in The Economist, Wired, and The New York Times, GA offers training in web development, data, design, business, and more, both online and at campuses around the world. Our global professional community boasts 60,000 full- and part-time alumni — and counting. In addition to fostering career growth for individuals, GA helps employers cultivate top tech talent and spur innovation by transforming their teams through strategic learning. More than 21,000 employees at elite companies worldwide have honed their digital fluency with our upskilling and reskilling initiatives. GA has also been recognized as one of Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500, and Fast Company has dubbed us leaders in World-Changing Ideas as well as the #1 Most Innovative Company in Education.

GA is at the leading edge of creating practical solutions to one of the most pressing challenges of our time - the future of work. As recognized by The World Economic Forum, BCG, the OECD and more, these are big challenges to which only a few companies are offering real solutions. In this role, you'll be speaking every day to corporate leaders who rely on GA to help them apply these solutions to their workforce of the future.

As a Lead Learning Experience Designer (LED), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and contextualizing high-quality GA learning programs for enterprise, technical, and professional audiences. This role requires strong learning experience design knowledge, excellent program development and project management skills, and hands-on fluency with AI tools and emerging workplace technologies.

You will create practical, outcome-driven learning experiences that help learners build relevant skills and apply them with confidence in real workplace contexts. Because AI is increasingly embedded across GA programs and client needs, you should understand how modern AI tools are actually used in the workplace and be able to translate that fluency into applied activities, labs, simulations, facilitator guides, assessments, and client-specific adaptations.

While this role will contribute significantly to GA’s AI-enabled and emerging technology portfolio, it is not a purely AI curriculum role. The core responsibility is to create scalable, high-quality GA programs that meet learner needs, client goals, market expectations, and GA’s instructional standards.

You will project manage and collaborate with subject matter experts, instructors, product managers, learning designers, assessment specialists, vendors, and client-facing teams to create learning experiences that reflect current market needs, emerging capabilities, and practical workplace application.

Terms and Details:

  • This is a flexible, contractor position on a 2 or 3 month term
  • We would expect someone to provide 30 hours per week when on a project
  • This role will be 100% remote
  • For US Candidates: Pay is between $45 and $55 USD per hour
  • For European Candidates: Pay is between €23 and €35 Euros per hour
  • For South Asian Candidates: Pay is between $15 and $25 USD per hour
  • For APAC Candidates: Pay is between $20 and $38 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities:

Program Ownership & Discovery

  • Serve as the Lead Learning Experience Designer for GA programs that may include AI, emerging technology, digital transformation, technical skills, leadership, role-based application, or workplace productivity components.
  • Own the complete Client-facing Design Process; requirements gathering, learning outcomes, project timelines, scope, resourcing, development plans, and content quality from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with sales, product, client success, solutions, and delivery teams to identify client and learner needs and translate those needs into practical learning solutions.
  • Support pre-sales and client conversations by helping define skill needs, learner personas, program objectives, audience readiness, and recommended learning pathways.
  • Evaluate the tools, workflows, use cases, and workplace contexts most relevant to a client or learner audience, including AI tools where relevant, and determine how they should be represented in the learning experience.
  • Define clear learning outcomes that move learners from awareness to practical application, workflow improvement, productivity gains, behavior change, and responsible technology use.

Applied Learning Design & AI-Enabled Development

  • Design and develop practical, instructor-led learning experiences for learners at varying levels of expertise, including programs where AI tools, workflows, or emerging technologies are central to the learner outcome.
  • Create instructor-led training materials, including slides, hands-on labs, case studies, simulations, assessments, facilitator guides, learner workbooks, and practical workplace exercises.
  • Build learning experiences that help learners actively apply new skills in realistic workplace contexts, including the use of AI tools and platforms where relevant.
  • Design hands-on activities using current workplace and AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Midjourney, NotebookLM, or other tools relevant to enterprise learning.
  • Translate complex or technical concepts into structured, accessible, and engaging learning experiences in partnership with subject matter experts.
  • Curate, contextualize, and update content to reflect emerging industry trends, new tool capabilities, evolving best practices, accessibility expectations, and responsible use considerations.
  • Design structured learning pathways across levels of proficiency, including AI literacy, role-based application, technical skill development, workflow redesign, responsible technology use, and advanced concepts where appropriate.
  • Develop practical, interactive exercises such as tool walkthroughs, prompt refinement activities, workflow mapping, use case development, ethical decision-making scenarios, productivity tasks, coding challenges, technical labs, or real-world business simulations.
  • Ensure learning experiences are grounded in adult learning principles, learning science, accessibility, measurable learner outcomes, and practical transfer to the workplace.
  • Follow GA’s design and development standards, best practices, templates, QA processes, and productization expectations for core and customized curriculum.
  • Create, execute, and own the quality of project and program development timelines, deliverables, and required resources.
  • Onboard and project manage all resources required for program development, including SMEs, other LEDs or instructional designers, assessment specialists, instructors, vendors, contractors, and freelancers.

Delivery & Instructor Enablement

  • Develop instructor enablement materials to support live classroom training delivery, including facilitator guides, run-of-show documents, learner workbooks, real-world case studies, tool setup instructions, troubleshooting guidance, and activity facilitation notes.
  • Provide guidance to instructors on best practices for applied, interactive learning, including live tool demonstrations, coaching, discussion facilitation, learner support, applied exercises, and technology-supported problem solving.
  • Work closely with instructors, learning facilitators, and client teams to tailor learning programs for diverse audiences, including enterprise clients, startups, government organizations, technical teams, business leaders, and cross-functional employee populations.
  • Ensure instructors are equipped to deliver learning experiences confidently, accurately, consistently, and in alignment with GA’s instructional standards.
  • Collect, synthesize, and analyze data on learning impact to support continuous improvement, content refinement, learner outcomes, and program updates.
  • Where applicable, work with translation vendors and localization partners to adapt learning experiences for global audiences.

Productization

  • Lead conversations and workflows with product management and learning systems design teams to standardize reusable GA learning patterns, components, activities, templates, and program structures.
  • Contribute to the development of a scalable library of reusable GA learning components, including program structures, activities, assessments, facilitator resources, client-ready assets, and AI-enabled learning patterns where relevant.
  • Identify which custom learning materials can be converted into reusable product components or repeatable delivery models.
  • Support the evolution of GA’s learning portfolio by identifying emerging client needs, market shifts, tool trends, and opportunities for new or improved learning products.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design, curriculum design, or a related field, with significant experience creating instructor-led training content.
  • Demonstrated ability to design high-quality learning experiences for enterprise, professional, technical, or workplace audiences.
  • Strong experience creating practical, outcome-driven learning materials, including slides, facilitator guides, activities, assessments, case studies, labs, simulations, and learner resources.
  • Experience managing clients, stakeholders, SMEs, instructors, vendors, or cross-functional partners through a content development process.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies, including Bloom’s Taxonomy, ADDIE, experiential learning, practice-based learning, and adult learning principles.
  • Ability to design for both technical and non-technical audiences, including leaders, business teams, functional teams, and technical practitioners.
  • Hands-on fluency with current AI tools and the ability to use those tools to design, prototype, evaluate, and improve learning experiences.
  • Demonstrated experience designing learning experiences related to AI, emerging technology, data, digital transformation, technical skills, or workplace technology adoption.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI concepts, including generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, machine learning, AI agents, ethical AI, responsible use, and enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience designing practical, hands-on learning activities that may include AI tools, labs, case studies, simulations, workflow exercises, or tool-based practice.
  • Experience collaborating with subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into structured, engaging, and accessible learning experiences.
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, content management systems, and authoring tools.
  • Willingness to flex your schedule to join meetings across time zones, particularly in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments where priorities, tools, and client needs evolve quickly.
  • Passionate about helping diverse learners build practical, future-facing skills for the changing world of work.

Nice to Have:

  • Technical proficiency in AI, data science, or coding, including Python, APIs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience using GitHub or other technical collaboration tools.
  • Experience designing AI training labs, coding exercises, model-building workshops, or real-world AI case studies.
  • Familiarity with virtual machines, cloud-based labs, sandbox environments, or technical learning environments.
  • Experience integrating AI-driven personalization, adaptive learning, or AI-supported learner practice into course design.
  • Experience designing enterprise AI adoption programs, leadership AI programs, role-based AI academies, technical academies, digital transformation programs, or role-based learning journeys.
  • Experience creating learning experiences for tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, NotebookLM, Midjourney, or similar platforms.

Unless otherwise noted, remote positions can be performed from the following approved General Assembly operating countries.

United States of America (states of operation may vary), Canada (provinces of operation may vary), United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore.

raw.title: Back-end Developer
raw.excerpt: Nummo builds software for recruiting teams that run many searches at once.
raw.description:
Nummo builds software for recruiting teams that run many searches at once. A recruiter’s day is a chain of small decisions: a new job opens, a candidate is added, a screen is passed, a client wants to meet, a time is agreed, an invite goes out, a result comes back, an offer is signed, and the search is closed. Each of those moments already lives somewhere else, in an applicant tracking system, a notes tool, a calendar, a spreadsheet, or a chat. Nummo’s job is to keep one search coherent across those tools, so the recruiter can say what happened and have the rest of the record move with her.

The backend is where that coherence is enforced. The desktop app is the place a recruiter talks to a search. The API, the database, and the workers behind it are what turn a sentence into a durable change: a candidacy, a milestone, a task, a calendar event, a stage move, a row on a tracking page. Those writes have to land in the right order, on the right search, for the right candidate, and they have to be safe to retry when a provider is slow or a worker restarts. This role owns that path.

You will design and ship the services that open a search from an external job, attach candidates, and advance them through the stages a firm actually uses. You will work on the agent runtime that reads a recruiter’s message, plans the writes for that turn, and delivers them. You will work on the workflow engine that opens the next task when a milestone is recorded, and that leaves a task alone when the step is already satisfied. You will work on the integrations that talk to applicant tracking systems, calendars, documents, and notes tools, including the polling and webhook paths that notice a new job without anyone creating it by hand.

A normal week mixes product work with operational care. One day you are adding a step to a recruiting workflow and proving that a chat message books the interview, moves the candidate, and records the milestone. The next day you are tracing a run that looked stuck because a write was delivered immediately and the interface had nothing left to approve. You will read production evidence when something fails, fix the narrow cause, and add the check that would have caught it. You will also delete the old path. We do not keep a second implementation around once the new one is the one callers use.

The system is a TypeScript monorepo. The API serves the desktop app and the workers. Postgres holds organizations, searches, candidacies, tasks, actions, and the links back to external objects. Temporal runs the agent loop and the scheduled jobs, including the poll that looks for newly published jobs. The desktop app is Electron. The interesting backend problems are not in rendering. They are in identity, ordering, and partial failure. A candidate can exist as a person, as a candidacy on one search, and as an applicant on an external job, and those three records have to stay tied together. A milestone recorded today can open a task on the day of the interview rather than the day it was typed. A chat write and a task run can both try to update the same description, and the newer one has to win. An invite can be sent at the moment it is created, so a missing approval card is not the same thing as a failure.

You should have built and operated backend systems that other people depend on. You are comfortable with relational data, with transactions, and with the ways a unique index or a soft delete changes what “already exists” means. You have shipped integrations against third-party APIs, including their rate limits, their draft-versus-published states, and their habit of returning success for a write that is not yet visible. You can read a stack from an HTTP request through a workflow history and say which step is still running. You write TypeScript that other people can change next month. You prefer a small function with a precise name over a comment that explains a muddy one.

You do not need to have worked in recruiting. You do need to care what the recruiter sees. A stage slug, a guest list, and a task title are product behavior, not internal details. When a message says a client wants to meet a named candidate, the system should record that, tell her what to send the candidate, and wait for the confirmed time. When she gives the time and the client’s email, the system should book a 30-minute online meeting for the client and the candidate, move the applicant, and close the booking tasks. When she says the candidate signed, the search should fill and the closing work should open. If you have opinions about how those steps should feel, we want them, grounded in how the current path actually behaves.

We work in the open inside the company. Changes land through pull requests with a clear description of the behavior, the risk, and what was verified. A change to authentication, authorization, schema, billing, or a send path gets a closer look than a change to copy. We verify recruiting behavior with the real app and, where the change is a prompt, with repeated model runs, not only with a unit test that asserts its own mocks. Production access for diagnosis is read-only. We do not fix a live search by writing around the product.

The team is small. You will talk to the people who use the product, including the recruiting firms we are in production with, and you will sit with a full search from the moment a job is published to the moment the offer is signed. That loop is the job. The backend engineer we hire will make that loop shorter and harder to get wrong: fewer stuck runs, fewer duplicate tasks, fewer invites with the wrong guests, and a record that still matches the story the recruiter would tell a client at the end of the search.

Who We're Looking For - Senior Account Manager

The Penny Hoarder is looking for a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of strategic partner relationships, driving revenue and gross margin growth while shaping how those partnerships evolve over time. You'll manage partners across financial services and other consumer categories in our portfolio. Priority verticals include banking, credit cards, lending, insurance and investing.

This is a highly visible role with real ownership over account performance and growth. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to partners, using performance data and market knowledge to identify growth opportunities, negotiate pricing and budgets, and expand successful partner relationships. You'll work cross-functionally with paid media, yield, editorial and product teams to improve campaign performance to meet both TPH and partner goals.

This role is ideal for a seasoned account leader who pairs strong relationship skills with sharp analytical judgment, someone who doesn't just manage accounts but grows them. You'll also serve as a resource for the broader team, sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for how we manage partnerships.

We are open to remote candidates. Candidates must be willing to work on Eastern Time.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Own a portfolio of partner accounts, driving revenue, gross margin and long-term growth for both The Penny Hoarder and our partners
  • Identify and pitch opportunities to improve monetization, scale high-performing partnerships, and expand long-term account value
  • Balance revenue and gross margin growth with partner KPIs, traffic quality, and long-term account health
  • Analyze performance at the offer, placement and source level to deliver data-backed recommendations that improve results
  • Build strong working relationships with partners and internal teams across paid media, editorial, product and operations

What Success Looks Like

  • Grow portfolio revenue, gross margin and partner budget allocation against established targets
  • Expand partner relationships into additional products, channels, sponsorships and flat-fee opportunities
  • Consistently meet partner performance targets and maintain strong account retention
  • Maintain accurate campaign reporting, tracking, and account documentation across assigned partners
  • Identify material performance changes early, explain the business impact and recommend next steps
  • Lead business reviews and partner meetings with clear analysis and specific recommendations
  • Maintain strong workflows, documentation and follow-through, and share learnings that help the broader team improve

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of client-facing experience in account management, partnerships or business development, with a track record of growing accounts
  • Experience in affiliate or performance marketing, with financial services experience strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of CPA, CPL, CPC, flat-fee and other digital media pricing models, including how each affects partner performance and yield
  • Proven ability to negotiate pricing, payouts, budgets and contract terms
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both partners and internal teams
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate work across teams without direct authority
  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple accounts
  • Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to identify next steps and take action
  • Experience with TUNE or similar affiliate and tracking platforms is a plus
  • Occasional schedule flexibility may be required for time-sensitive partner needs

Perks That Set Us Apart

  • 💰 Invest in the Future: Enjoy 401(k) matching after just two months of employment, with employer matching starting at ~3%.

  • 🏝️ Flexible Time Off: We offer competitive time-off balances that accrue weekly, just like your paycheck. (Yes, we’re paid weekly too!)
  • 👶🏻 Parental Leave: We provide 2 weeks of paid parental leave during the first year and up to 9 weeks after one year of employment.
  • ✈️ Generous Paid Holidays: Celebrate cultural diversity with additional flex holidays in addition to our company paid holidays.
  • 🏠 Remote Work Options: Skip the daily commute, and embrace the flexibility of working from home.
  • 🛟 Comprehensive Life Insurance: Ensure peace of mind with coverage that extends beyond the workplace with employer paid life insurance (including coverage for dependents and spouses).
  • 🤝 Employee Resource Groups (ERGs): Join us in fostering connections, celebrating diversity, and providing a supportive community for all.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Lead to join a KYC Due Diligence squad working on a strategic Client Lifecycle Management transformation.

You will combine hands-on Java development with technical leadership and strong knowledge of Fenergo/Fen-X, KYC, onboarding, screening, and risk assessment. The role will contribute to the evolution of the CLM platform, including AI-enabled transformation, architectural simplification, and the definition of effective delivery and workforce strategies.

What you will do

  • Provide technical leadership within the KYC Due Diligence squad.
  • Lead the delivery and evolution of Fenergo/Fen-X and Client Lifecycle Management capabilities.
  • Contribute hands-on to the design and development of Java-based solutions.
  • Translate KYC, onboarding, screening, and risk-assessment requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define technical standards, priorities, and delivery approaches for the squad.
  • Review solution designs and code to ensure security, maintainability, performance, and quality.
  • Guide senior and mid-level developers and support knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Work with business, compliance, risk, product, and architecture stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the existing architecture and reduce unnecessary complexity.
  • Support AI-enabled transformation initiatives within the KYC and CLM ecosystem.
  • Contribute to workforce and capability planning for the platform.
  • Manage technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs in a complex financial-services environment.

Required:

  • 6–10 years of relevant professional experience, with proven technical leadership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrable delivery experience with Fenergo/Fen-X in enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Client Lifecycle Management processes and technology.
  • Solid functional and technical understanding of KYC and Due Diligence.
  • Experience with customer onboarding, screening, and risk-assessment processes.
  • Senior-level, hands-on Java development experience.
  • Ability to make and explain technical decisions in complex or critical environments.
  • Experience guiding developers, leading technical discussions, or coordinating delivery within a squad.
  • Advanced English,C1 level

Nice to have:

  • Experience simplifying complex or legacy architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled transformation within KYC, CLM, compliance, or financial crime.
  • Experience defining workforce, skills, or delivery-capacity strategies.
  • Experience working with global banking or financial-services organisations.
  • Knowledge of integration patterns, APIs, workflow platforms, and event-driven architecture.
  • Experience working with compliance, risk, operations, and product stakeholders.

What do we offer you?

  • 100% Remote set up
  • Training and career development
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects

raw.excerpt: The Legal Counsel II, Privacy & Data Protection will provide practical, business-oriented legal advice on U.
raw.description:
The Legal Counsel II, Privacy & Data Protection will provide practical, business-oriented legal advice on U.S. and global privacy matters across Nielsen’s products, services, commercial relationships, and internal operations. This role will support the development and operation of Nielsen’s privacy program and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Information Security, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams.

  • Advise on privacy compliance, data governance, and risk mitigation for business operations, products, data partnerships, and commercial transactions.

  • Apply expanded knowledge and experience in privacy and data protection law while continuing to develop higher-level expertise.

  • Solve a range of privacy and commercial legal problems using sound judgment, established frameworks, and practical business analysis.

  • Draft, review and negotiate complex data protection exhibits on both the buy-side and sell-side.

  • Receive moderate guidance and direction while taking ownership of assigned matters and workstreams.

Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day legal guidance on U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including the CCPA/CPRA and the evolving patchwork of comprehensive state privacy statutes, as well as applicable sectoral, consumer protection, marketing, and data security requirements.

  • Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of U.S. state privacy regulations and translate legal developments into clear, actionable guidance, contract language, policies, notices, processes, and implementation requirements.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate data processing agreements (DPAs), data protection and security terms, data use and sharing agreements, and related privacy provisions in commercial contracts, representing Nielsen both as a data buyer/customer and as a data seller, provider, or service provider.

  • Conduct and support privacy impact assessments (PIAs/DPIAs) for products, features, data uses, partnerships, and other initiatives; identify risks, recommend mitigations, and help embed privacy by design and by default.

  • Conduct privacy due diligence on third parties, vendors, customers, and strategic partners, including reviewing questionnaires and security materials, assessing processing activities and data flows, identifying gaps, negotiating remediation, and supporting ongoing oversight.

  • Advise on advertising technology, audience measurement, analytics, identity, cookies, pixels, SDKs, targeted advertising, consent and preference management, data monetization, and related media and marketing data practices. Experience in adtech is strongly preferred.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Information Security, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to assess proposed data collection, use, disclosure, retention, and deletion activities and to support compliant launches and operational changes.

  • Support privacy incident and data breach response, consumer and data subject rights escalations, regulatory inquiries, audits, and other privacy compliance matters in coordination with relevant internal teams and outside counsel.

  • Contribute to privacy program materials, including policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, training, records of processing, data inventories, and compliance reporting.

  • Monitor changes in privacy and data protection laws and enforcement trends, assess their impact on Nielsen’s business, and communicate concise recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment and provide clear, timely, and pragmatic advice to both legal and non-legal audiences.

Role-Level Expectations

  • Understands key business drivers and uses this understanding to accomplish assigned work.

  • Solves standard and moderately complex problems by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedent.

  • Has no supervisory responsibilities but may provide guidance to new associates or colleagues.

  • Explains privacy and legal information to others in straightforward and actionable terms.

  • Requires expanded conceptual knowledge in privacy and data protection while developing additional skill sets.

  • Impacts the quality of own work and the work of the team while operating within applicable guidelines and policies.

  • 2 - 5 years of experience practicing privacy, data protection, technology, commercial, or related legal work, preferably in-house or in a law firm advising technology, media, advertising, data, or analytics businesses.

  • J.D. or equivalent legal qualification and admission to at least one U.S. state bar, consistent with the requirements for the role.

  • At least 2 years of experience with U.S. state privacy regulations, including the CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, with the ability to interpret requirements and operationalize them across products, contracts, and business processes.

  • At least 2 years of experience with demonstrated experience conducting or supporting DPIAs/PIAs and privacy risk assessments, including documenting risks and tracking mitigation measures.

  • Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating DPAs and other privacy-related contract terms, including experience advising both buyers/customers and sellers/providers of data or services.

  • Strong legal research, writing, negotiation, analytical, and issue-spotting skills, with the ability to explain complex privacy requirements in clear business terms.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively with moderate supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of APAC privacy and data protection regulations -particularly India’s Digital Personal Data Protection framework, Australia’s Privacy Act and Australian Privacy Principles, or South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act - greatly preferred, but it is not a hard requirement.

  • CIPP/US certification is a significant advantage.

  • Adtech, Martech, media measurement, audience analytics, data licensing, or digital advertising experience is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with the GDPR/UK GDPR, international data transfers, cross-border data sharing, and related contractual mechanisms.

  • Familiarity with consent and preference management, IAB frameworks such as the Global Privacy Platform or Transparency and Consent Framework, privacy management tools, data mapping, and records of processing activities.

  • Additional privacy certification, such as CIPM, CIPT, or an equivalent credential, is a plus.

it's what's inside that counts

There’s more to CMC than our products and the buildings, structures, and roads they go into. At CMC, it’s the people inside our recycling centers, fabrication plants, manufacturing facilities, steel mills and offices that make us who we are as a company. Our success comes from finding, retaining, and supporting the highest quality talent by offering:

  • Day 1 Benefits Coverage with low cost Medical, Vision and Dental
  • Day 1 Paid-time Off and Vacation
  • 4.5% Company Match 401(k) Plan
  • $500 Annual Company-paid Lifestyle Benefit
  • Competitive Compensation and Bonuses
  • Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Training and Advancement Opportunities

Why This Job

CMC provides an excellent opportunity to learn the steel, construction reinforcement and ground stabilization industries and to grow in your career. Whether you will spend your day brainstorming in an office cubicle, operating a crane, running manufacturing equipment or troubleshooting technical obstacles, at CMC, you’ll get the training and support from your team that you need to excel in your role and reach your full potential.

What You'll Do

  • Develop cost effective geotechnical solutions using proprietary technologies including Rammed Aggregate Pier systems for project teams
  • Coordinate interaction between GFC Design Center, Licensed Installer and Client to maximum efficient, accuracy, and effectiveness of GFC services and systems.
  • Responsible for generating sales leads, managing and tracking key projects and communicating project status via monthly reports
  • Implement engineering/bid strategies to close business and achieve proposals and solutions to meet regional revenue goals
  • Review project geotechnical and structural information and perform project evaluations to examine technical and commercial feasibility
  • Prepare proposals and work with estimators to provide project bids for RAP opportunities
  • Review, sign, and seal project design submittals and field reports and prepare project close-out submittals

What You'll Need

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in a geotechnical/structural engineering field
  • Minimum 2 years sales experience preferred
  • Registered professional engineer with active license, in good standing
  • Ability to quickly evaluate both technical and commercial viability of opportunities to provide value to project teams
  • Demonstrate ability to create and manage business opportunities resulting in successful engineering and sales strategies

Your Education

  • BS in Civil Engineering required – MS in geotechnical engineering preferred.

We are CMC, a Fortune 500® company at the leading edge of our industry. Our construction reinforcement and steel products have supported construction projects and structures around the world. The secret to our success? We’ve built our legacy by assembling a team of innovators and doers to tackle some of the most challenging construction reinforcement problems facing our world for more than 100 years — and we’re just getting started.

If you’re ready to join a team working to make our industry more sustainable, support the bridges, roadways, buildings and infrastructure that connects our communities, and do meaningful work, you’re ready to join CMC. Apply today and start moving your career — and our world — forward. Let's build a better world!

This role reports to the VP of HR who is based in the USA.

Purpose of Role
The purpose of this role is to provide ongoing HR administration services to the UK and international teams spanning five countries, ensuring that all legal requirements relating to employment and management of individuals across the international division are met. Specifically, this will include ensuring that all employee relations issues and employee-related processes from recruitment to termination are handled fairly, equitably, and in accordance with local legislative requirements, company policy, and good practice. This role will also provide advice and support to local managers in all necessary areas, and suggest changes to keep Embarcadero (and other Idera Inc. subsidiaries) up to date with good practice and workplace trends.

Key Customers
  • All employees based in the international Company
  • External Agencies
Location & Working Terms
  • The working hours will be 20 hours per week. The precise working days, hours, and pattern will be arranged to suit the job holder and the needs of the business.
  • This role is remote.
  • The International region currently covers employees in the following countries: Czech Republic, France, Germany, Netherlands, and the UK. Flexibility is required to occasionally work outside normal working hours to deal with telephone calls and to participate in remote meetings in other time zones.

Responsibilities and Duties
The HR Administrator will be specifically responsible for the following areas:
  • Database management
  • Managing annual leave and monitoring of all absences
  • Creating and tracking employee documentation
  • Liaising with the Finance team and Operations team regarding Employee data
  • Obtaining employment references
  • Tracking probation
  • Processing new starters and leavers
  • Filing and record keeping
  • Guiding and assisting managers in handling all sensitive employee relations issues in accordance with prevailing local legislative requirements, and in accordance with company policy
  • Providing confidential support to employees
  • Ensuring company policies and the Staff Handbook are kept up to date with legal, policy, and procedural changes throughout the international region, and advising the business on necessary changes
  • Acting as the main point of contact to explain any policy queries to managers and employees
  • Helping managers conduct interviews and other sensitive staff meetings as and when required
  • Supporting managers in handling disciplinary and grievance issues
  • Managing terminations and redundancy meetings and handling associated documentation, legal discussions and advice
  • Monitoring and assisting line managers with the management of long-term sickness absence
  • Producing job offers and contracts of employment across the international division (in dual/foreign languages with appropriate support where required)
  • Providing references for employees needing company backing for mortgages/loans/housing, and on work records for ex-employees seeking new employment
  • Managing personal data updates for payroll and record keeping purposes
  • Conducting an annual data check exercise, updating all necessary records and files
  • Handling incoming emails from third-party providers and inquiries
  • Acting as the primary point of contact for solicitors and lawyers in the event of any employee disputes, or when expert legal advice is required to support the business
  • Assisting the Finance team in managing employee benefits, and undertaking ad hoc work and administration related to employee benefits as required
  • Participating in due diligence and merger/acquisition/TUPE work from time to time and ensuring that all employee-related matters arising as part of such projects are handled in a timely and professional manner
  • Undertaking special HR-related projects and other activities from time to time as requested
As with all jobs at Idera, the company expects that any employee will be flexible and willing to undertake any other duties from time to time which are reasonably requested by their manager.

Key Targets and KPIs
  • Reports to be submitted weekly, monthly, and annually as needed
  • Absence monitored weekly
  • References to be obtained within the employee’s probationary period
  • New employee details to be provided to Finance before the payroll deadline

Qualifications, Experience & Personal Skills
  • Educated to degree level and/or experience in general office administration in an HR environment
  • Must be fully CIPD qualified or equivalent experience
  • Must have significant commercial Generalist HR management experience at a senior level, ideally in a small team or autonomous standalone role
  • Must have some international HR experience and knowledge, ideally including across some of the countries in which the international division operates
  • Ideally will have worked in the software sector and for a US-owned organisation
  • Must have and be able to maintain strong, up-to-date knowledge of UK employment law, and good general knowledge of other international employment law in relevant countries
  • Must have experience of liaising with international lawyers to take detailed advice, and then be confident and competent to act unilaterally upon it and be the onward conduit to advise the business
  • Must have experience of working with multiple priorities and meeting deadlines, often in a pressured environment
  • Must have good business acumen
  • Must have solid MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • Able to take direction or work independently and produce results with minimal supervision
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills in English; a second European language would be useful but is not a prerequisite
  • Self-motivated and organised with the ability to prioritise effectively
  • Process-driven, with strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of information, written or spoken, with regard to all employee matters
  • Approachable and professional, with the ability to exercise tact and discretion at all times

The role demands deep technical expertise, an eye for detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and innovation.

  • Minimum 3–4 years of experience in SAP IRPA (Desktop version, Process Automation, SAP Build / Contextor – Mandatory).

This role ensures that goods and services are procured appropriately, vendors are paid accurately and timely, AP records are complete, accurate, and up to date, and reliable AP information is available to support FP&A, while protecting the company through strong controls, consistent policies, transparent global reporting, and disciplined purchasing practices.

  • Domain: Identity and Access Management (IAM) software

What makes this project exciting?

Are you ready to join a game-changing force in identity and access management?

Our client is revolutionizing the way enterprises protect user identities in a passwordless world. You'll be working at the intersection of cutting-edge biometrics, behavioral analytics, and next-gen identity orchestration - helping the world’s leading brands safeguard millions of users. Backed by more than 100 M Series A - one of the largest in cybersecurity history - and trusted by major global enterprises, they offer the agility of an innovator with the strength and backing of an industry leader.

Ready to take part in redefining IAM for the modern era? Let’s talk.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in security research, mobile security, browser research, fraud research, detection research, reverse engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Experience with web browsers, mobile browsers, WebViews, browser APIs, JavaScript runtime behavior, browser automation, fingerprinting, client-side web security, and low-level browser technologies.
  • Familiarity with the architecture or codebase of modern open-source browsers and rendering engines, such as Chromium, WebKit, Blink, or Gecko, with the ability to reason about how browser internals can expose new security and fraud signals.

  • Research browser, WebView, Android, and iOS environments from an attacker’s perspective.

  • anti-detection methods.

The Business Development Coordinator will work closely with Business Development Manager, Business Development Specialist, colleagues in the Business Development, Marketing, and Communications (BDMC) department, and Technology, Manufacturing, & Transportation (TMT) SBU leadership to drive marketing and business development projects and initiatives for the SBU.
