raw.title: Senior Power BI Developer
raw.excerpt: Title:Senior Power BI DeveloperWe are KBRWhen you become part of our KBR team, your opportunities are endless.
raw.description:
Title:

Senior Power BI Developer

We are KBR

When you become part of our KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through internal collaboration, and with our partners and customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the innovative solutions to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to Zero Harm and our Sustainability Platform.

In September 2025, we announced that we are spinning our Mission Technology Solutions business into a separate public company. This role would ultimately be part of that new company. Our Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions. From national security and readiness to advanced research, cyber, logistics, and life-cycle sustainment, our teams help customers solve complex challenges in some of the world’s most demanding environments. Whether supporting operations on the ground, at sea, in the air, or in space, our clients trust us to deliver mission-critical capabilities every day.

Working with us means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions.

As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution.

We are IT

We are strategic enablers of the business, delivering scalable, secure, and innovative technology solutions that drive operational excellence and support enterprise growth. We partner closely with functions across the organization to modernize systems, unlock data-driven insights, and enhance the digital employee experience. Our global footprint and commitment to transformation position us at the forefront of leveraging technology to create lasting business value.

About the Role

The Senior Power BI Developer is responsible for the design, development, administration, governance, and support of enterprise business intelligence and reporting solutions. This role serves as a technical expert for Microsoft Power BI and related BI technologies, partnering closely with business stakeholders, DBAs, ETL developers, data engineers, and application teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Power BI, SSAS, SSRS, and enterprise data architectures with strong analytical and communication skills. This position plays a key role in defining BI standards, optimizing reporting environments, supporting data-driven decision-making, and driving continuous improvement across the organization's business intelligence capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and support enterprise business intelligence solutions utilizing Power BI, SSAS Tabular, SSRS, and related reporting technologies.
  • Lead requirements gathering, solution architecture, system design, estimation, development, testing, deployment, training, and ongoing support activities.
  • Design and govern enterprise semantic models, including reusable measures, hierarchies, standardized calculations, KPIs, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
  • Develop advanced DAX calculations and optimize data models, SQL queries, and reporting solutions for performance, scalability, and usability.
  • Design and deliver executive dashboards and interactive reports utilizing Power BI best practices for visualization, accessibility, and data storytelling.
  • Integrate and analyze data from enterprise data warehouses, Azure Data Lakes, Power BI Dataflows, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Support Power BI tenant-to-tenant migrations, including dependency analysis, artifact refactoring, validation, and governance compliance.
  • Collaborate with DBAs, ETL developers, data engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated BI and analytics solutions.
  • Define and promote BI strategy, architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Architect and support enterprise data marts, SSAS Tabular models, and business intelligence environments in partnership with data platform teams.
  • Administer reporting environments, including platform configuration, security, installation, patching, and user support.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues while performing root cause analysis and implementing long-term solutions.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, data models, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Lead quality assurance activities across solution design, development, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Mentor developers and analysts while contributing to workload planning, project estimates, and delivery timelines.
  • Provide training, end-user support, and guidance to business stakeholders to promote adoption and effective use of BI solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting capabilities, data accessibility, governance, and user experience.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power BI.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience supporting enterprise data warehouse and business intelligence environments.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working with SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS).
  • Experience deploying, supporting, and administering large-scale business intelligence solutions.

Business Intelligence & Data Expertise:

  • Strong experience with Power BI administration, including configuration, security, governance, and user management.
  • Extensive experience developing complex Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and advanced DAX calculations.
  • Extensive experience developing and supporting SSAS Tabular models.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis, dimensional modeling, data architecture, and relational database concepts.
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise data marts and business intelligence architectures.
  • Experience leveraging Azure Data Lakes, lakehouse architectures, Power BI Dataflows, and modern analytics platforms.
  • Experience performing migrations across BI environments and platforms.

Technical Knowledge & Core Competencies:

  • Strong SQL development and performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working with Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases.
  • Experience utilizing SQL development and administration tools such as SSMS, Toad, or SQL Navigator.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to support users across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power BI Fabric and emerging Microsoft analytics technologies.
  • Experience supporting Azure-based data and analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of data governance, master data management, and enterprise reporting best practices.
  • Experience leading BI modernization, migration, or cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Experience mentoring developers or serving as a technical lead on BI projects.

Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description: Seeq creates cutting-edge data analytics software for industrial process data, serving sectors like pharmaceuticals, energy, and manufacturing.

raw.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: Seeq creates cutting-edge data analytics software for industrial process data, serving sectors like pharmaceuticals, energy, and manufacturing.
raw.description:
Seeq creates cutting-edge data analytics software for industrial process data, serving sectors like pharmaceuticals, energy, and manufacturing. Our core product is a robust calculation engine capable of executing advanced math and machine learning algorithms on streaming time-series data. By leveraging generative AI, we enhance usability and accelerate outcomes for our users.

As a fully remote company, Seeq fosters collaboration using tools like Zoom, Slack, and our own Qube Virtual Office. With a focus on agile principles, our team of talented engineers is dedicated to building products that exceed customer expectations while nurturing a supportive, collaborative environment.

Your Passion:

Passionate about crafting exceptional software, you revel in writing code with elegance, extensibility, and maintainability as your guiding principles.

Your Skills:

Always striving to perfect your craft, you excel as a teammate. Meticulous and detail-oriented, you advocate for unit testing, continuous integration, and elegant solutions. Bugs are your adversaries, and you take pleasure in immediately squashing them.

Having reached a high potential for your own output, you’ve begun taking on leadership roles and mentoring others to help scale up your team.

Collaboration:

Eager to collaborate through pair-programming or other means to contribute to team acceleration, you consistently participate in code reviews and take advantage of them as positive learning opportunities, both for yourself and others on the team.

The Tech Stack:

Comfortable across the tech stack, you excel in a JVM language or Python for backend functionality. Your expertise may extend to databases, distributed computing, and cloud platforms. When working on the front-end, you craft visually appealing pages for our Typescript + React application.

Your Drive:

Interested in finding the best way to solve problems, you want to have an impact that extends beyond your individual technical contributions. Armed with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience, you bring years of experience as a Senior software development engineer, leading successful development efforts within your team. Proactive in seeking and providing feedback, you maintain open communication about growth opportunities with your manager(s) and colleagues. Getting together in person once a year is something you’d look forward to. Seeking work-life balance, you aspire to contribute your skills to a startup with a promising future, surrounded by a diverse group of intelligent, collaborative individuals. Your desire to join Seeq is motivated by a belief that it is a perfect fit for your skills and aspirations, as evident in your application cover letter response to the question, “What makes Seeq a good fit for you?”

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
  • Substantial professional experience in software development, with a solid record of designing, building and evolving complex software systems over a period of years
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of software design principles, patterns, and best practices
  • Expertise in building large React applications with TypeScript
  • Expertise in one or more backend languages, such as Python or Node.js?
  • Ability to work effectively across frontend and backend codebases, owning features end-to-end
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with great attention to detail
  • Proven leadership skills, with the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools, such as Scrum or Kanban

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary plus bonus incentives.
    • $145,000 USD.
  • Benefits:
    • 12-week paid Seeq family leave
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Internet and mobile phone reimbursements
    • Medical benefits
    • Group term life insurance
    • Short-term and long-term disability insurance pre-tax benefits
    • Voluntary vision and dental (ortho)
    • Vacation bonus program
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Generous home office allowance
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)
    • Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home)
    • You love your job!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

You must be authorized to work in the country in which you reside. Seeq does not sponsor US F1 or H-1B work visas

raw.title: Business Process Analyst
raw.excerpt: Eaton’s ES AMER MCO division is currently seeking a Business Process Analyst.
raw.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER MCO division is currently seeking a Business Process Analyst. This is a remote role that can sit anywhere in the United States, with preference given to individuals residing within the eastern and central time zones.

What you’ll do:

The Business Process Analyst will be a hands-on leader who will collaborate with cross-functional teams on key business process and technology improvements across several products that support the execution of the Construction Digitalization initiative. The Business Process Analyst will support the creation and implementation of efforts to optimize workflows and technology innovation related to the construction project lifecycle. They will be part a team tasked with accelerating and connecting digital capabilities that enhance design, simulation and digital twin deployment to better position Eaton as a preferred partner. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, analytical, highly organized, and resourceful in understanding complex processes, often with limited documentation. Further, the Business Process Analyst will be a leader in embracing and driving strategic change, challenging the status quo, while garnering business support and alignment towards streamlined processes. A successful Business Process Analyst is customer focused, solutions-oriented and fosters collaborative, productive working relationships amongst business stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Business Process Optimization: Assess current design and configuration processes to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for standardization, improvement and automation that focus on enabling Eaton as the basis of design.
  • Process Design & Implementation: Lead and support the implementation of standardized, scalable processes and digital workflows across multiple product lines to improve execution and adoption.
  • Change Management & Continuous Improvement: Apply change management and continuous improvement methodologies to drive successful adoption, compliance, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Project Management & Delivery:Partner with IT and other teams to execute project plans, documentation, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure timely delivery of high quality user and business solutions.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, and remote teams to align priorities, resolve constraints, and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Digital Enablement & Measurement:Support digital initiatives through training, hands on enablement of key users, and collection of metrics to evaluate performance and inform continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited educational institution
  • Minimum 5 years experience in electrical or construction industry
  • Minimum 3 years experience in digital capability development, sales, project management, commercial construction projects, customer support or digital customer experience.
  • Relocation is not available. Candidates must currently reside within the United States to be considered.
  • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

-

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of the construction project lifecycle including design and submittal processes
  • Change management and design thinking experience
  • Knowledge of design and engineering software: Revit / BIM, Enovia, Bluebeam, etc.
  • Knowledge of Bidmanager/CPQ electrical equipment configuration
  • Knowledge of Salesforce
  • Knowledge of Autodesk suite of products including Autodesk’s Forma
  • Knowledge of design thinking methodologies
  • Knowledge of Jira

Position Criteria:

  • Ability to collaborate digitally with global teams, build internal and external relationships to achieve project goals and drive change

  • Strong organizational skills – ability to manage the timely execution of multiple tasks and projects

  • Strong communication and presentation skills – both verbal and written with ability to create status reports and technical presentations to stakeholders

  • Demonstrated customer focused skills and behaviors

The expected annual salary range for this role is $97000 - $143000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

The application window for this position is anticipated to close on 10/9/2026.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. title: Technical Project Manager, Emerging Transportation Technology
description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities.

raw.title: Technical Project Manager, Emerging Transportation Technology
raw.excerpt: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities.
raw.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

We are looking for a motivated and curious Technical Project Manager who is ready to grow their career while taking on meaningful responsibility across technology-focused client engagements. This role offers the opportunity to manage projects, work directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, develop expertise in emerging solutions, and gain broader exposure to the business behind the projects. As part of Parsons X, you will bring together client teams, Parsons technical and business resources, partners, and subcontractors to solve complex problems and deliver successful outcomes, while building the experience needed to take on increasingly complex project leadership roles.


This position is well suited for someone with several years of experience supporting or managing technology projects who is ready for greater ownership and responsibility. We are not necessarily looking for the most seasoned Project Manager. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sound judgment, initiative, and the drive to grow.


Approximately 70% of the role will focus on project delivery, with the remaining time supporting Parsons X business operations and strategic priorities.

An initial area of focus will be Asset Guardian, a growing Parsons X solution that brings together sensor-generated and other infrastructure data to help clients put trusted asset information to work within their existing environments. Early engagements will include pilots and smaller implementations, with the opportunity to manage larger and more complex implementations as client adoption grows.


This role is not limited to Asset Guardian. The Technical Project Manager will have opportunities to support other Parsons X technology projects and emerging solution engagements based on client and business needs.

The role reports directly to the head of Parsons X, providing exposure to leadership priorities, client engagements, proposals and pursuits, management briefings, presentations, and other initiatives across the business. For someone who is curious about how projects, clients, technology, people, and growth come together, this role offers a unique opportunity to develop a broader business perspective while building a project management career.


Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery and Client Management

  • Manage technology projects and client engagements from initiation through completion, including scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, risks, issues, and overall project performance.
  • Bring together client teams, Parsons technical and business resources, partners, and subcontractors to create an integrated project team with clear roles, shared priorities, and accountability for delivery.
  • Lead internal and client project meetings, establish clear objectives, facilitate productive discussions, capture decisions and action items, and ensure commitments are followed through to completion.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, dashboards, status reports, financial forecasts, risk and issue tracking, and other tools required to provide clear visibility into project health and outcomes.
  • Communicate project status succinctly to clients, project teams, and leadership, focusing on progress, outcomes, schedule, financial performance, risks, decisions, and required actions.
  • Manage project budgets and forecasts and understand how project performance, staffing, scope, and schedule decisions affect monthly and overall financial results.
  • Identify risks and issues early and take an active role in driving them toward resolution.
  • Build trusted client relationships and confidently take the lead in client conversations, including on-site meetings and project activities when appropriate.
  • Listen beyond immediate project requirements to understand broader client needs and identify opportunities where Parsons may be able to provide additional value.
  • Foster collaboration across organizations and disciplines, working through competing priorities and differing perspectives while keeping teams focused on shared project outcomes.

Emerging Solutions and Technology Delivery

  • Serve as Project Manager for Asset Guardian pilots and implementations, as well as other Parsons X technology and emerging solution engagements as assigned.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of the solutions being delivered, including the technology, data, client environment, and intended business outcomes.
  • For Asset Guardian, develop an understanding of how sensor and other infrastructure data are generated, processed, and integrated into client environments.
  • Work closely with solution leaders, technical teams, clients, partners, and subcontractors to coordinate implementation activities and resolve delivery issues.
  • Develop sufficient solution knowledge to confidently support customer demonstrations, onboarding, training, and ongoing client engagement.
  • Help establish repeatable project management processes, templates, tools, and delivery practices that can scale as emerging solutions mature and client adoption grows.
  • Apply sound project management practices while remaining flexible enough to work in technology environments where the solution or delivery approach may continue to evolve.

Business Operations and Leadership Support

  • Support coordination of Parsons X quarterly business briefings and other leadership activities, including gathering information from business leaders and developing clear, executive-level materials.
  • Coordinate across the Parsons X leadership team to gather information, track commitments, and support management reporting and business priorities.
  • Support development and coordination of proposals, client deliverables, sales presentations, and other business materials.
  • Help prepare for important internal and external presentations by organizing information, developing and refining presentation materials, and helping ensure key messages are communicated clearly and professionally.
  • Provide hands-on coordination for special initiatives, client activities, and other business priorities as needs arise across Parsons X.

What Will Make You Successful


You take ownership. You do not wait to be told every next step. You see what needs to happen, take initiative, and follow through. When something is at risk, you surface it early and help drive it toward resolution.

You are a collaborative project leader. You know successful delivery depends on bringing people together around a common outcome. You work effectively across client teams, Parsons technical and business teams, partners, and subcontractors. You clarify roles and expectations, work through differences constructively, and create the alignment and accountability needed to keep teams moving forward.

You are organized without being bureaucratic. You value schedules, budgets, forecasts, action items, dashboards, and accountability because they help move the work forward, not because project management is simply about maintaining a process.

You are comfortable with ambiguity. Some assignments will have established processes. Others, particularly emerging solution engagements, may not. You can apply sound project management thinking while helping determine the best way forward.

You are curious about technology. You do not need to be the technical expert, but you want to understand how the solution works, how the pieces fit together, and how technology and data help solve a client's problem. You can learn enough to communicate confidently with clients and technical teams.

You communicate clearly and succinctly. You can run a meeting, ask good questions, listen, capture what matters, and leave people clear about decisions, responsibilities, and next steps. You can also turn complex information into a concise project dashboard, executive update, proposal, or presentation.

You are financially minded. You understand that successfully managing a project includes managing the business of the project. You pay attention to budgets, forecasts, scope, changes, and the financial implications of project decisions.

You are comfortable with clients. You enjoy building relationships, are confident taking the lead in client conversations, and listen for what the client is really trying to accomplish. You recognize where Parsons may be able to help solve additional problems and expand the value we provide.

You are present, responsive, and dependable. People know they can count on you. You follow through, close loops, communicate proactively, and remain engaged and accessible to clients and internal teams.

You are willing to roll up your sleeves. You are not overly concerned with whether something falls perfectly within your job description. Whether it is resolving a project issue, improving a presentation, preparing for an important client meeting, or pulling together information for a leadership briefing, you are willing to jump in and help get it done.

You want to grow. You may not have every skill required to manage a large, complex technology program today. You have the foundation, judgment, curiosity, initiative, and ambition to develop into that level of project leader.


What We Are Looking For

  • Several years of experience supporting or managing technology-focused projects, with demonstrated readiness to take on increasing project ownership and responsibility.
  • Strong foundational project management skills across scope, schedule, budget, risk, issues, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Experience managing project budgets and forecasts, with an understanding of project financial performance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and organizational boundaries.
  • Confidence interacting directly with clients, technical teams, partners, subcontractors, business leaders, and senior leadership.
  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation-development capabilities, including the ability to organize complex information into clear, professional, executive-ready materials.
  • Comfort learning new technology and working with technical subject matter.
  • A self-starter mindset with demonstrated initiative, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • Experience with intelligent transportation systems, sensors, data platforms, infrastructure technology, or related environments is a plus, but is not required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed to support client engagements, project delivery, training, presentations, and other business needs.

Working Environment


This is a remote position that requires a high degree of engagement and responsiveness throughout the workday. The successful candidate will maintain a professional remote work environment that supports focused work, frequent virtual meetings, and regular interaction with clients, project teams, partners, and senior leadership.


Because this is a highly visible and client-facing position, the Technical Project Manager should be comfortable working on camera and maintaining a professional presence during virtual client and internal meetings. Title:

Senior IT Development Lead

We are KBR

When you become part of our KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through internal collaboration, and with our partners and customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the innovative solutions to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to Zero Harm and our Sustainability Platform.

In September 2025, we announced that we are spinning our Mission Technology Solutions business into a separate public company. This role would ultimately be part of that new company. Our Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions. From national security and readiness to advanced research, cyber, logistics, and life-cycle sustainment, our teams help customers solve complex challenges in some of the world’s most demanding environments. Whether supporting operations on the ground, at sea, in the air, or in space, our clients trust us to deliver mission-critical capabilities every day.

Working with us means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions.

As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution.

We are IT

We are strategic enablers of the business, delivering scalable, secure, and innovative technology solutions that drive operational excellence and support enterprise growth. We partner closely with functions across the organization to modernize systems, unlock data-driven insights, and enhance the digital employee experience. Our global footprint and commitment to transformation position us at the forefront of leveraging technology to create lasting business value.

About the Role

The Senior IT Development Lead is responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise software solutions that support business objectives and technology strategy. This role provides technical leadership across development teams, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with architectural standards and modern software engineering practices.

Operating at the intersection of application development, architecture, and delivery leadership, the Senior IT Development Lead drives the successful execution of technology initiatives while promoting Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in the Microsoft technology stack with proven leadership experience managing development teams and enterprise application delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead development teams in the design, development, implementation, and support of enterprise applications.
  • Serve as a technical leader responsible for application architecture, integration strategies, and adoption of development best practices.
  • Drive the development and maintenance of applications, including coding, testing, debugging, deployment, and production support activities.
  • Establish priorities, manage project timelines, and ensure successful delivery aligned with business objectives and IT strategy.
  • Guide the adoption of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver effective technology solutions.
  • Evaluate existing systems and recommend enhancements, modernization initiatives, and new technology solutions.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of supported applications.
  • Provide leadership and guidance in resolving complex technical challenges, production incidents, and system issues.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, technical specifications, solution designs, and development standards.
  • Lead Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, code reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate development efforts across global teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure successful project execution.
  • Mentor and support developers through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and professional development opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required.
  • 8+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on the Microsoft technology stack.
  • Proven experience leading development teams and delivering enterprise-scale applications.
  • Experience working in Agile and Scrum-based software delivery environments.
  • Experience supporting production systems and resolving complex technical issues.

Application Development & Technical Expertise:

  • Strong experience with C#, .NET Framework, .NET 6/8+, and modern web application development.
  • Experience developing applications using ASP.NET (Web Forms and MVC) and RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
  • Knowledge of application architecture, system integration, and software development best practices.

Leadership & Core Competencies:

  • Ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical teams while managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to address complex technical challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and business audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across cross-functional and global teams.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage competing demands, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Blazor and modern UI frameworks.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation technologies such as ARM templates or Terraform.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and containerization technologies.
  • Exposure to DevSecOps practices and secure software development standards.

Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
The Financial Services Solution Architect team is looking for an extraordinary person to join an experienced team of Quants and Data Scientists, engaging the finance industry with compelling examples of full-stack accelerated computing. Solution Architects work with top minds with Financial Services Capital Markets and Exchange firms to accelerate High-Performance Computing and AI workloads across various use cases. We’re seeking an inquisitive, hard-working, and creative individual passionate about helping solve challenges. Join us in this endeavor!

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Partner with NVIDIA Engineering, Product, and Sales teams to secure design wins at customers. Enable development and growth of NVIDIA product features through customer feedback and proof-of-concept evaluations.

  • Perform proof-of-concepts working side by side with clients, engineers, and other architects on in-depth analysis, profiling and optimization of machine learning/deep learning models to ensure the best performance on current- and next-generation GPU architectures.

  • Work directly with client ML researchers and developers/engineers on business-impacting workflows, projects, and issues to drive success using NVIDIA technology.

  • Facilitate rapid resolution of customer issues and promote the highest levels of customer satisfaction.

  • Build collateral (notebooks/ blogs) applied to Finance industry use-cases such as ML/DL, recommender systems, GNN, monte-carlo simulations, Quantitative Finance, etc. by working closely with customers.

What We Need To See:

  • MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or other Engineering fields (or equivalent experience)

  • 5+ years experience as an ML/Software Engineer with a proven track record in writing code in Python, C++

  • Experience with ML/DL algorithms with frameworks such as PyTorch, Spark, Dask, Jax, TensorFlow

  • Ability to communicate ideas and share code clearly through blog posts, GitHub

  • Enjoy working with multiple levels and teams across organizations (engineering/research, product, sales, and marketing teams)

  • Effective verbal/written communication and technical presentation skills

  • Self-starter with a passion for growth, a real enthusiasm for continuous learning, and sharing findings across the team

  • Skilled in deploying ML/DL models at scale on public cloud computing and/or on-prem HPC clusters in production

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Demonstrate C/C++ programming proficiency with an understanding of software design, programming techniques, and algorithms, alongside experience performing performance optimizations.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures.

  • GPU Development experience through NVIDIA CUDA-x libraries, cuBLAS, cuDNN.

  • Knowledge of MLOps technologies such as containers, data center deployments, cluster management software, etc.

  • Experience working with enterprise developers building HPC or data analytics applications.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until June 15, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Manage and grow a portfolio of existing agency relationships within the small and middle-market segments by cultivating client partnerships, retaining business, and expanding premium finance loan volume. Serve as a trusted advisor by educating agency clients on products, systems, and processes while delivering exceptional service and support. Monitor competitive activity and market trends within the assigned territory to identify growth opportunities. Collaborate with internal business partners to support client needs and operational objectives. Represent the organization at industry events and actively promote Premium Finance solutions to strengthen brand awareness and drive new business opportunities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
1. Develop and maintain profitable business by making sales calls on insurance agents/brokers, insurance companies and general agencies that meet PF standards.
2. Develop and maintain relationships with existing clients in order to maintain or expand loan volume by identifying problems and providing solutions.
3. Manage assigned territory independently.
4. Monitor local insurance trends and make strategic recommendations to management, as needed.
5. Monitor local, competitive environments and make strategic recommendations to management, as needed.
6. Analyze monthly reports to identify opportunities to increase sales and minimize lost volume.
7. Ensure revenue goals are met by analyzing profitability for each relationship and recommending changes, as needed.
8. Communicate with marketing staff and operational staff to maximize opportunities.
9. Utilize Salesforce.com to record sales activity, meaningful information about sales calls and create follow-up activities.
10. Develop pricing proposals, as needed, and submit to management for approval.

QUALIFICATIONS
Required Qualifications:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Bachelor's degree in Business or related field, or equivalent education and related training
2. Five years of business-to-business sales experience, preferably in financial services or insurance
3. Excellent verbal and written communication skills
4. Strong organizational and time management skills
5. Self-motivated, independent worker
6. Ability to interpret financial data
7. Demonstrated proficiency in basic computer applications, such as Microsoft Office software products
8. Ability to travel, occasionally overnight

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Ability to interpret financial data

raw.description:
About the Team/Role:

WEX is transforming the Health & Benefits experience by modernizing a complex ecosystem of products that support consumer-directed healthcare accounts, payments, and employer solutions. As part of this effort, we are building a more unified, scalable platform that powers both current and next-generation experiences across our portfolio.

We are seeking a Product Manager III to drive execution across a large and complex direct business portfolio within Health & Benefits. This role is highly execution-focused and sits at the intersection of platform capabilities and customer-facing solutions. You will be responsible for delivering modern, scalable product improvements that reduce friction for large employers, improve operational efficiency, and mitigate attrition risk across our product suite.

This role offers broad exposure across multiple product verticals and requires strong cross-functional collaboration, technical fluency, and the ability to quickly ramp across domains. You will play a critical role in modernizing legacy systems while helping shape the foundation for future platform-driven innovation.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Drive execution across a large, complex portfolio of Health & Benefits products, ensuring delivery against key development priorities.

  • Own and manage product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery through delivery, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes.

  • Modernize existing products and contribute to building scalable, platform-driven solutions that improve customer and developer experiences.

  • Translate complex business needs into actionable product requirements, including user stories and backlog prioritization.

  • Partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Work within Agile frameworks, actively contributing to sprint planning, refinement, demos, and delivery processes.

  • Engage in technical discussions to help shape architecture decisions and ensure alignment with platform capabilities (e.g., APIs, integrations).

  • Manage multiple initiatives across varying levels of complexity and maturity, balancing speed with quality.

  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, measure success, and continuously iterate on product improvements.

  • Contribute to reducing customer attrition risk by improving product usability, efficiency, and value delivery.

  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with rapid turnaround and high visibility across teams.

Experience you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably within Health & Benefits, healthcare, fintech, or enterprise platforms.

  • Proven ability to deliver complex products with a strong focus on execution, outcomes, and continuous iteration.

  • Experience working in Agile environments collaborating with Engineering, Architecture, and Product Design teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Strong technical fluency, with experience working on or alongside API-driven architectures (e.g., REST, GraphQL, integrations, webhooks).

  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems across multiple domains.

  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously with competing priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to leverage data to inform decisions and measure impact.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts into business value and influence stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and build strong collaborative relationships.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.

  • Apply modern AI tools (e.g., LLM-assisted workflows, code-generation agents, predictive analytics) to streamline requirements generation, API mapping, and product delivery.

What will give you an edge:

  • Experience in consumer-directed healthcare products (e.g., HSA, FSA, benefits administration).

  • Background in platform or infrastructure product management, including building scalable, composable systems.

  • Experience modernizing legacy systems or contributing to digital transformation initiatives.

  • Ability to bridge platform and application layers to reduce complexity and improve developer experience.

  • Experience working with enterprise or large employer clients and solving complex operational challenges.

  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures or distributed systems.

  • Applied AI & Analytics: 2+ years of experience integrating practical AI/ML capabilities, predictive models, or LLM-driven automation into enterprise SaaS, fintech, or healthcare platforms.

  • Intelligent Workflows: Hands-on experience using AI for data extraction, document processing (e.g., automated claims/receipt matching), fraud detection, or conversational self-service in portal environments.

  • AI Tooling & Methodology: Familiarity with leveraging modern AI-assisted tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate product discovery, PRDs, user story creation, and API prototyping.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $89,800.00 - $120,400.00

raw.description:
Looking for hands-on experience in search and content marketing? Our career-launching intern program is calling your name!

The SEO Sherpa internship is a 12-week fast-start into a search engine marketing career.

You’ll get to learn, grow, and develop your skills in all aspects of search engine marketing, from pay-per-click advertising to organic SEO, and content marketing to conversion rate optimization (CRO) and overall account management of campaigns with various budgets. The program will inspire, educate, and prepare you to succeed in an entry-level role at SEO Sherpa and beyond.

The program covers:

  • What is SEO, and why it is important.
  • How to manage a campaign successfully.
  • How to interact with clients.
  • How to conduct successful meetings.
  • How to do keyword research and analyze search intent.
  • Content creation strategies for search success.
  • Comprehensive on-page optimization techniques (from A-Z).
  • How to convert more traffic through Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO).
  • What is link building, and why you need it.
  • How to build backlinks with blogger outreach and digital PR
  • Technical SEO, techniques, and best practices
  • And, much more!

This program is designed for post-graduates or someone with minimal professional SEO experience. The program begins with six weeks of dedicated, hands-on training across all of our agency functions. After that, you’ll be assigned an assessment so we can see how far you’ve come. Once done, a select few of you will continue for another six weeks (paid) where you’ll work on actual client projects — developing the skills you need to kick-start a career in search and content marketing.

No color-coordinating calendars, labeling files, or taking lunch orders when interning at SEO Sherpa. You’ll be working on real clients while gaining real-world experience working side-by-side with world-class experts.

Overview:

    • We take you from zero to hero. Only post-graduates or those with minimal professional SEO experience should apply.
    • A program covering approximately 20 hours per week of training.
    • A priceless experience training you on all areas of SEO, and if brought over to the final six weeks, earn yourself $500
    • Covers all aspects of content marketing and search engine marketing, end-to-end.
    • Full-time roles are offered to selected top graduates.

The next program is still to be confirmed, however estimated to begin by the 2nd half of 2026.
The program is split into 2 cycles, the 1st cycle focuses on solely training; where you will get a 6 week program covering all areas of SEO. The Second cycle is another 6 weeks which transitions you through working alongside the team on client deliverables.

We are accepting applications throughout the year in preparation for the next internship. If selected we will reach out to you via email and confirm the actual start date.

Requirements

We are looking for passionate search marketers in the making. You should live and breathe digital marketing and are ready to learn new skills which you'll apply to real-world clients including fast-growth startups and world-leading brands.

Is This Program Right for You?

If you answer “YES” to all these it'll be a great fit….

  • You have a well-rounded background steeped in digital marketing and/or communications.
  • You’re results-driven, hungry to succeed - and excited to help our clients and agency do the same.
  • You are bright, passionate, committed to getting the job done, and motivated to challenge yourself daily.
  • You have exceptionally high standards. You are always raising the bar. In your world great isn't good enough.
  • You're a focused and motivated self-starter, with excellent time management skills and a rock-solid work ethic.
  • Lastly, you are passionate about digital marketing and have a fun-going attitude. This is a must.

Benefits

Here's what you can expect:

  • Market-leading hands-on training that will prepare you for a career in digital marketing.
  • Learn from the best-of-the-best in their fields.
  • The opportunity to work with a talented team on an important mission.
  • Real-world experience working on actual client accounts.
  • A fun work culture where we value your work and our client's business.
  • Consideration for an entry-level role at SEO Sherpa on completion of the 12-weeks.

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for an Environment Artist / Generalist with strong hands-on art skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both creating high-quality 3D art and helping teams work more clearly, consistently, and efficiently. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to asset creation, world building, scene assembly, feedback, task breakdowns, workflow documentation, quality reviews, and cross-studio collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable artist with a strong art eye, a practical production mindset, and the ability to help translate creative direction into actionable work for other artists.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support team alignment, mentor other artists, improve workflows, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Create high-quality 3D environment art, props, modular assets, materials, set dressing, and world-building content across a variety of visual styles.
  • Work from concept art, reference, style guides, blockouts, client direction, or incomplete/vague creative briefs to produce clear and polished results.
  • Build, assemble, and integrate assets and environments in Unreal Engine, with attention to composition, readability, performance, and technical requirements.
  • Support the full environment art pipeline, including modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, material creation, optimization, engine integration, and final polish.
  • Review artwork from internal teammates, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help translate broad client or project feedback into specific tasks, priorities, notes, and acceptance criteria that artists can execute against.
  • Assist with maintaining visual consistency across assets, scenes, and artists by helping define quality bars, style expectations, and review standards.
  • Collaborate with art directors, leads, producers, technical artists, designers, engineers, and artists across multiple studios and time zones.
  • Help identify production risks early, including unclear direction, workflow gaps, quality issues, technical constraints, or schedule concerns.
  • Contribute to workflow and pipeline improvements that help the team work more efficiently and consistently.
  • Document processes, best practices, feedback, and workflow guidance when needed using tools such as Confluence, Miro, or Jira.
  • Balance visual quality, production efficiency, and performance requirements while supporting the needs of each project.

Requirements

    • 5+ years of professional experience as a 3D Environment Artist, Generalist, World Artist, or similar role in games or real-time production.
    • At least one shipped game or comparable real-time interactive project.
    • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality environment art, world building, prop creation, materials, and/or scene assembly.
    • Strong artistic eye for form, composition, lighting, material definition, scale, visual hierarchy, and style consistency.
    • Ability to work across different visual styles, from realistic to stylized, depending on project needs.
    • Experience creating both individual assets and assembled environments/scenes.
    • Solid understanding of the full environment art pipeline, including modeling, UV layout, baking, texturing, materials, optimization, and engine implementation.
    • Professional experience with Unreal Engine.
    • Proficiency with common production tools such as Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Photoshop.
    • Practical understanding of real-time performance considerations, including LODs, draw calls, texel density, texture memory, collision, lightmaps, shaders/material complexity, scene organization, and asset budgets.
    • Strong communication skills, especially when giving feedback, clarifying direction, documenting decisions, or breaking down complex problems.
    • Ability to take vague or high-level direction and turn it into clear, actionable work.
    • Comfortable collaborating with artists, leads, producers, and cross-discipline partners.
    • Able to give and receive feedback professionally, clearly, and constructively.
    • Strong ownership, follow-through, and problem-solving ability.
    • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

    • Previous experience mentoring artists, reviewing work, or informally supporting lead-level responsibilities.
    • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development, partner studios, or external vendors.
    • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
    • Experience providing feedback through written notes, paintovers, drawovers, video reviews, live calls, or structured review documents.
    • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
    • Experience helping define style guides, quality bars, workflow documentation, or art review standards.
    • Experience breaking down client feedback into Jira tasks, art notes, production plans, or acceptance criteria.
    • Experience with procedural workflows, Houdini, Blueprint, Python, scripting, or tool-assisted content creation.
    • Experience with optimization passes, performance profiling, memory budgets, or platform-specific art constraints.
    • Experience with both realistic and stylized production art.
    • Experience in multiple engines or real-time pipelines.
    • Experience working directly with clients or helping support client-facing reviews.

Portfolio Requirements

  • Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your environment art and/or generalist capabilities.
  • Strong portfolios should include:
    • Finished 3D environments, scenes, props, or world-building examples.
    • Examples rendered or captured in a real-time engine, preferably Unreal Engine.
    • Breakdowns showing your process, including blockout, modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, materials, set dressing, lighting, and final integration where applicable.
    • Examples that show your ability to work across different visual styles.
    • Examples of modular kits, reusable asset systems, material workflows, or production-friendly environment pipelines.
    • Any examples that show technical problem solving, optimization, performance-aware decisions, or efficient workflows.
    • If showing team-created work, please clearly explain what you personally contributed.
    • Nice to have: examples of feedback, mentorship, documentation, workflow improvements, style matching, or before/after improvements you helped guide.
    • Nice to have: written context explaining the goal of the work, constraints, tools used, your role, and any production challenges you helped solve.

Candidate Profile

  • The ideal candidate is not just a strong artist, but someone who naturally thinks about how the whole team succeeds.
  • You may be a great fit if you:
    • Care about making great-looking art and making the process better for the team.
    • Enjoy solving production problems, not just completing assigned assets.
    • Can look at a scene or asset and identify what is working, what is not, and how to improve it.
    • Communicate feedback in a way that is clear, respectful, and useful.
    • Can help artists understand not just what to change, but why it matters.
    • Are comfortable adapting to different clients, art styles, pipelines, and project needs.
    • Have the judgment to balance quality, speed, technical constraints, and team bandwidth.
    • Are interested in growing toward lead responsibilities while remaining hands-on in production.
  • English proficiency: B2 or higher required.
  • All applicants are required to submit their CVs in English as part of the application process.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

If working on some of the biggest and best titles with some of the coolest people within the games industry isn't enough, we also offer:

  • Work alongside dynamic individuals in the gaming industry
  • Work within a company with upward career growth opportunities
  • Work Fully Remote
  • Full Time Employment Benefits for applicants located in MX only include:
    • Comprehensive statutory benefits: social security, 12 days of annual leave, 30 days' Christmas bonus, and a 25% vacation premium.
    • After 3 months:
      • Major and minor medical insurance
      • Savings fund
      • Grocery vouchers ($1244.88 MXN)
  • Salary RANGE: 32k to 35k MXN gross per month

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

raw.description:
Overview

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at CrewAI is a pivotal, customer-facing role that bridges the gap between our cutting-edge AI technology and our clients' specific needs. We are looking for a hybrid technical expert and strategic consultant who can not only implement our solutions but also understand the business context to ensure successful integration, adoption, and value delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Integration

  • Lead the technical integration of CrewAI's products into customers’ systems, including API integrations, data pipelines, and custom workflows.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable solutions tailored to client requirements, leveraging your expertise in Python and other relevant technologies.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues during implementation and provide timely resolutions, collaborating with our internal engineering teams as needed.

Client Engagement & Solution Design

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact, thoroughly understanding the customers’ business objectives and technical landscapes.
  • Translate client needs into technical specifications and solution designs, ensuring alignment with CrewAI's product capabilities.
  • Design and architect CrewAI-powered agent teams, assigning specialized roles and workflows tailored to client needs.
  • Conduct technical workshops and training sessions for customer teams to facilitate product understanding and adoption.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers and Support Engineers, to ensure customers’ success and smooth operations

Deployment & Optimization

  • Deploy, configure, and optimize CrewAI-based multi-agent systems in production environments.
  • Develop and integrate custom agents, tools, and processes using Python and CrewAI’s open-source libraries.
  • Monitor deployed solutions for performance, reliability, and business value, rapidly iterating on agent roles and workflows to adapt to evolving client needs.

Requirements

Qualifications & Desired Skills

  • Proven experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with APIs and system integrations.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and technologies, including AI agent frameworks and LLMs.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of workflow orchestration, multi-agent systems, or distributed computing.
  • Experience building GenAI solutions and knowledge of design patterns, RAG, and working with various databases (SQL, NoSQL) are a plus.
  • Contributions to open-source AI agent projects or experience with human-in-the-loop systems is a significant bonus.

Team Collaboration

You will work closely with our Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to provide client feedback, resolve technical issues, support pre-sales activities, and ensure overall client satisfaction.

Performance Metrics

Your success will be measured by key indicators, including:

  • Successful project implementations and high client satisfaction.
  • Timeliness and effectiveness of technical support and issue resolution.
  • The quality of your solution designs and documentation.
  • Your contribution to product improvements through actionable client feedback.

VIRTUAL and FLEXIBLE | Secondary Math Teacher Tutor (up to 36/hr, 8AM-10AM ET)

Online Part-Time Tutoring. Powered by Teachers.

Perform VIRTUAL-only ELA and Math tutoring for K-12 students across the United States with flexible hours and higher pay than most tutoring companies. This role doesn’t require you to be in a classroom to work with students across the country. This role currently applies to teachers with experience teaching secondary math (teach lower-level HS math e.g. Integrated Math 1 and/or ACT prep) or ELA (eg. ACT English/Reading) for 9-12th graders. Must also be available 8AM-10AM ET on weekdays.

Tutored by Teachers seeks to close the opportunity gap and advance equity in education by supporting high needs students. We empower our nation’s teachers to provide part-time virtual tutoring to students across the country. You focus on teaching, we’ll take care of the rest. We find the places you’ll make the biggest impact. Join us in our exciting and rewarding mission!

Tutored by Teachers generally pays a rate of $32.00 per hour of tutoring (on a prorated basis) plus a 10% bonus meant to cover tutoring, light preparation, logging-in early to start a session, and session notes. For delivering a one hour tutoring session, that is $35.30 per session! Our pay rate is often more than 2X the rate many tutors receive for their services.

Please note for some other engagements where lessons/materials are provided to significantly reduce instructional lift, the rates are slightly reduced - e.g., $30 per hour of tutoring + 10% bonus.

This is not a full time role. Upon being admitted into our highly qualified TbT teacher community, you will be eligible to express interest and accept our tutoring engagement opportunities. Please note pay rates may vary for engagements you accept.

If you want to learn more about us, visit our website:

Apply Now! We’re excited to hear from you!

PLEASE ONLY APPLY TO ONE WORKABLE POST FOR TUTORING POSITIONS. THANKS!

The Role
We are seeking teachers to provide small group instruction virtually to students across the country (grades K-12)! We provide various engagement opportunities to our school partners, ranging from summer academies to remediation support.

Engagements can run anywhere between fourteen to thirty weeks, and usually require a few hours of commitment during the week. We can’t guarantee staffing once you've been admitted into our community, but it’s likely :)

Requirements

This role requires you to have experience as a US teacher.

To be successful in this role, you must have:

  • Experience teaching Math or ELA in the classroom
  • Experience teaching in an online environment
  • Working knowledge of Google Classroom and Zoom
  • Ability to teach lower-level HS math (e.g. ,Integrated Math 1, ACT prep) or ELA
  • Be available 8AM-10AM ET on Weekdays

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with remediation, intervention or small group instruction
  • Experience with secondary math
  • SPED or ELL teaching experience
  • Bi-Lingual
  • AP course experience (any APs) helpful!
  • Dedication to advancing equity in schools
  • Active teaching credential

Benefits

Staffing and Engagements

We’re currently adding teachers to our TbT Teacher Community for fall engagement opportunities. As we win new engagements, we reach out to our community first to share tutoring opportunities to fill needed positions. Apply now to join our community and receive updates on new tutoring opportunities first! Staffing isn't guaranteed, and usually follows school semesters, trimesters or quarters.

Once staffed for a tutoring engagement, our compensation rate is generally $32.00 per hour of tutoring (on a prorated basis) plus a 10% bonus and that total amount covers the tutoring session, logging in early, and light preparation. This rate may be modified for engagements where teachers are provided more or less lessons (e.g., $30 per instructional hour +10%). You can also apply to take on supplemental opportunities within the community, such as interviewing, customer success, working on content, or becoming a mentor teacher.
