Intertek is looking for a Subject Matter Expert in 3D Laser Scanning & Digital Twin Services for establishing, leading, and grow 3D laser scanning and reality capture services, including technical delivery, service definition, and commercial enablement across European and UK markets.

The selected profile will be responsible for building and operationalizing end-to-end reality capture services. This role combines deep hands-on technical expertise with commercial acumen and market knowledge. The SME defines procedures, selects and deploys equipment and software, integrates scanning outputs into digital twin ecosystems, and actively supports business development through client engagement and industry networks.

Responsabilities:

Service Setup & Technical Leadership

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve 3D laser scanning and reality capture service offerings.
  • Define standard operating procedures (SOPs), quality standards, workflows, and best practices.
  • Select, test, and deploy appropriate hardware (terrestrial, mobile, UAV-based scanners) and supporting equipment.
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize processing and modeling software for point clouds, mesh generation, and BIM integration.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, cybersecurity, and compliance with industry and client standards.

Digital Twin & System Integration

  • Integrate laser scanning outputs with BIM, asset management, GIS, and digital twin platforms.
  • Collaborate with IT, engineering, and digital teams to ensure interoperability and scalable architectures.
  • Support development of use cases such as asset verification, brownfield engineering, maintenance planning, and lifecycle management

Market & Client Development

  • Leverage strong knowledge of European and UK markets to identify priority sectors and clients.
  • Utilize existing professional network to open opportunities and support sales of laser scanning services.
  • Participate directly in client meetings, technical presentations, proposals, and solution design.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, translating business needs into practical technical solutions

Commercial & Strategic support

  • Support pricing strategies, cost models, and service differentiation.
  • Contribute to go-to-market strategies and service positioning.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies in reality capture and digital twins.

Knowledge Sharing & Strategic Support

  • Train and mentor internal teams in laser scanning technologies, workflows, and standards.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases, technical guidelines, and innovation initiatives.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and technical forums.

Requirements

  • Minimum 8–10 years of hands-on experience in 3D laser scanning, reality capture, or related geomatics/engineering fields.
  • Proven experience setting up and scaling laser scanning services, including procedures, equipment, and software.
  • Strong understanding of BIM, digital twin platforms, and data integration workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience working with clients in European and UK markets.
  • Established network of potential clients, partners, or industry contacts relevant to laser scanning services.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in surveying, geomatics, engineering, architecture, or related discipline.

Skills

  • Deep technical expertise combined with practical, hands-on delivery capability.
  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to support sales and client development.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both technical and non-technical.
  • Ability to work across disciplines and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build services from the ground up.
  • High standards of professionalism, integrity, and quality focus.

As a Keller Haldren Partner, you will have the freedom to build and grow your own recruitment business, your way, while benefiting from:

It is not an offer of employment in Hong Kong and is not intended to constitute job-placement services in Hong Kong. Keller Haldren has no employing entity or licensed employment agency in Hong Kong. raw.title: VFX Artist - GameSim - Talent Pipeline
raw.excerpt: Liquid Development is hiring on behalf of GameSim, a Keywords Studio.
raw.description:
Liquid Development is hiring on behalf of GameSim, a Keywords Studio. This position will support GameSim production teams.

GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Liquid Development was founded in 2000 and is the largest outsourcing art studio in North America. We offer a fun and cooperative work atmosphere, where collaboration is encouraged among a diversely talented team to remain on the cutting edge of content creation. Everyday Liquid Development is producing work at the forefront of modern game production and the demands for our services continue to grow. Our team has contributed to AAA titles within the Halo, Mass Effect, Borderlands, and Call of Duty franchises - Liquid Development is the team these titles turn to when they need the best.

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for a VFX Artist with strong real-time effects skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating high-quality visual effects while also helping teams stay aligned, organized, and efficient. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to hands-on VFX production, in-engine implementation, feedback, task breakdowns, optimization, workflow documentation, and cross-discipline collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable VFX artist with strong fundamentals, a practical production mindset, and the ability to translate creative or design direction into clear, executable effects work.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support small pods or strike teams, guide VFX quality, mentor other artists, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Create custom real-time visual effects and implement them in-engine using Unreal Engine 5, Unity, or proprietary tools.
  • Build high-quality effects for gameplay, environments, cinematics, atmosphere, combat, interaction, destruction, UI/game feedback, and other project needs.
  • Create all necessary textures, flipbooks, materials, meshes, simulations, and supporting assets for real-time VFX.
  • Maintain clean, readable, well-structured material graphs, Niagara systems, parameters, naming conventions, and reusable effect setups.
  • Use tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen, or other software as needed to support effect creation.
  • Work with complex material setups, Blueprints, scripting hooks, animation events, gameplay triggers, or engine-specific implementation needs.
  • Troubleshoot VFX issues in partnership with Technical Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines.
  • Own VFX optimization fundamentals, including particle counts, overdraw, shader cost, texture memory, spawn rates, scalability settings, and platform performance constraints.
  • Help ensure effects are readable, performant, and aligned with gameplay needs, art direction, timing, mood, and player feedback.
  • Review work from internal artists, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help maintain a consistent quality bar across a set of effects, a feature, a level, or a small team pod.
  • Support short-term planning by helping break down VFX requests into clear tasks, priorities, dependencies, risks, and definitions of done.
  • Proactively identify production risks, including missing gameplay hooks, performance spikes, unclear direction, pipeline gaps, dependency issues, or inconsistent style execution.
  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Concept Artists, Art Directors, Technical Artists, Engineers, Animators, Audio Designers, and Producers.
  • Support client-facing communication when needed by clarifying requirements, sharing WIP, explaining constraints, and aligning on expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to VFX workflow improvements, reusable templates, documentation, libraries, naming standards, or scalability rules when appropriate.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional game industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist or similar role.
  • At least one shipped game title.
  • Proven end-to-end real-time VFX workflow experience, from concept and asset creation through in-engine implementation and polish.
  • Strong experience implementing effects in Unreal Engine 4 or 5, with strong working knowledge of Niagara.
  • Strong particle animation fundamentals, including timing, rhythm, shape language, motion, impact, anticipation, dissipation, and readability.
  • Strong understanding of natural energies and materials such as fire, smoke, water, electricity, magic, dust, debris, explosions, atmospherics, and environmental effects.
  • Strong material and texture creation skills using tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, or similar software.
  • Ability to create clean, readable, and well-constructed material graphs and VFX systems.
  • Demonstrated understanding of real-time VFX optimization, including particle counts, overdraw, memory usage, material cost, scalability, and performance constraints.
  • Ability to balance visual impact, gameplay clarity, technical cost, and production schedule.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear written updates, verbal communication, documentation, and actionable feedback.
  • Ability to interpret vague creative, design, or client direction and turn it into clear VFX tasks or implementation plans.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or guiding other artists. A formal Lead title is not required, but leadership behaviors are important.
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and working with design, engineering, technical art, production, and art direction.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, organization, and problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
  • Houdini experience.
  • EmberGen experience.
  • Unity experience.
  • Substance Designer experience.
  • Experience with proprietary engines or custom VFX tools.
  • Scripting or coding skills, such as C#, Python, Blueprint, or similar.
  • 2D animation or traditional animation experience.
  • 3D animation, simulation, or procedural content creation experience.
  • Experience creating both stylized and realistic effects.
  • Experience with foliage, atmospherics, environmental effects, weather, destruction, or ambient world VFX.
  • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development teams, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience establishing VFX standards, templates, naming conventions, libraries, scalability rules, or pipeline documentation.
  • Experience supporting client reviews, milestone deliveries, or cross-studio feedback loops.
  • Experience leading a small pod, strike team, feature group, or informal group of artists.
  • English proficiency: B2 or higher required.
  • All applicants are required to submit their CVs in English as part of the application process.

Portfolio Requirements

  • Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your real-time VFX capabilities.
  • Your portfolio must include:
    • Real-time VFX assets with strong readability, timing, shape language, and clearly understandable visual elements.
    • At least one example shown in a real-time gameplay context, preferably a video of the effect happening in-game or during interactive gameplay.
    • Examples of strong material definition and texture work, with clean, readable, well-constructed setups.
    • Effects that demonstrate fundamentals such as composition, mood, color choices, timing, motion, impact, readability, and understanding of natural energies.
    • Examples of effects implemented in-engine, preferably in Unreal Engine 4 or 5 / Niagara.
    • Breakdowns showing your process, including textures, materials, emitters, timing, implementation, optimization, or technical setup where applicable.
    • Clear explanations of what you personally created, especially for any team-created work.
  • Strongly preferred portfolio examples include:
    • Before/after examples showing how you improved an effect through feedback, mentorship, optimization, or art direction.
    • A small set of effects that demonstrate consistent style, quality bar, or gameplay readability across a feature or content set.
    • Examples of templates, libraries, material systems, naming conventions, scalability setups, or pipeline improvements you helped create.
    • Examples that show how you balanced visual quality with performance constraints.

Please note: if your portfolio is mostly isolated effects in presentation scenes without runtime gameplay context, this may not be the right fit. We are looking for artists who understand how VFX function inside real-time gameplay, not just how they look in isolation.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

If working on some of the biggest and best titles with some of the coolest people within the games industry isn't enough, we also offer:

  • Work alongside dynamic individuals in the gaming industry
  • Work within a company with upward career growth opportunities
  • Work Fully Remote
  • Full Time Employment Benefits for applicants located in MX only include:
    • Comprehensive statutory benefits: social security, 12 days of annual leave, 30 days' Christmas bonus, and a 25% vacation premium.
    • After 3 months:
      • Major and minor medical insurance
      • Savings fund
      • Grocery vouchers ($1244.88 MXN)
  • Salary RANGE: 32k to 35k MXN gross per month

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at at .

Al introducir tu información en esta aplicación, comprendes que la recopilaremos y procesaremos de acuerdo con nuestro Aviso de privacidad del candidato. Para obtener más información, consulta nuestro Aviso de privacidad del candidato en at .

Employment Type: Full Time

raw.description:
Liquid Development is hiring on behalf of GameSim, a Keywords Studio. This position will support GameSim production teams.

GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Liquid Development was founded in 2000 and is the largest outsourcing art studio in North America. We offer a fun and cooperative work atmosphere, where collaboration is encouraged among a diversely talented team to remain on the cutting edge of content creation. Everyday Liquid Development is producing work at the forefront of modern game production and the demands for our services continue to grow. Our team has contributed to AAA titles within the Halo, Mass Effect, Borderlands, and Call of Duty franchises - Liquid Development is the team these titles turn to when they need the best.

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for a VFX Artist with strong real-time effects skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating high-quality visual effects while also helping teams stay aligned, organized, and efficient. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to hands-on VFX production, in-engine implementation, feedback, task breakdowns, optimization, workflow documentation, and cross-discipline collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable VFX artist with strong fundamentals, a practical production mindset, and the ability to translate creative or design direction into clear, executable effects work.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support small pods or strike teams, guide VFX quality, mentor other artists, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Create custom real-time visual effects and implement them in-engine using Unreal Engine 5, Unity, or proprietary tools.
  • Build high-quality effects for gameplay, environments, cinematics, atmosphere, combat, interaction, destruction, UI/game feedback, and other project needs.
  • Create all necessary textures, flipbooks, materials, meshes, simulations, and supporting assets for real-time VFX.
  • Maintain clean, readable, well-structured material graphs, Niagara systems, parameters, naming conventions, and reusable effect setups.
  • Use tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, Blender, Houdini, Maya, EmberGen, or other software as needed to support effect creation.
  • Work with complex material setups, Blueprints, scripting hooks, animation events, gameplay triggers, or engine-specific implementation needs.
  • Troubleshoot VFX issues in partnership with Technical Art, Engineering, Design, Animation, Audio, and other disciplines.
  • Own VFX optimization fundamentals, including particle counts, overdraw, shader cost, texture memory, spawn rates, scalability settings, and platform performance constraints.
  • Help ensure effects are readable, performant, and aligned with gameplay needs, art direction, timing, mood, and player feedback.
  • Review work from internal artists, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help maintain a consistent quality bar across a set of effects, a feature, a level, or a small team pod.
  • Support short-term planning by helping break down VFX requests into clear tasks, priorities, dependencies, risks, and definitions of done.
  • Proactively identify production risks, including missing gameplay hooks, performance spikes, unclear direction, pipeline gaps, dependency issues, or inconsistent style execution.
  • Collaborate closely with Designers, Concept Artists, Art Directors, Technical Artists, Engineers, Animators, Audio Designers, and Producers.
  • Support client-facing communication when needed by clarifying requirements, sharing WIP, explaining constraints, and aligning on expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to VFX workflow improvements, reusable templates, documentation, libraries, naming standards, or scalability rules when appropriate.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional game industry experience as a real-time VFX Artist or similar role.
  • At least one shipped game title.
  • Proven end-to-end real-time VFX workflow experience, from concept and asset creation through in-engine implementation and polish.
  • Strong experience implementing effects in Unreal Engine 4 or 5, with strong working knowledge of Niagara.
  • Strong particle animation fundamentals, including timing, rhythm, shape language, motion, impact, anticipation, dissipation, and readability.
  • Strong understanding of natural energies and materials such as fire, smoke, water, electricity, magic, dust, debris, explosions, atmospherics, and environmental effects.
  • Strong material and texture creation skills using tools such as Photoshop, Substance Designer, or similar software.
  • Ability to create clean, readable, and well-constructed material graphs and VFX systems.
  • Demonstrated understanding of real-time VFX optimization, including particle counts, overdraw, memory usage, material cost, scalability, and performance constraints.
  • Ability to balance visual impact, gameplay clarity, technical cost, and production schedule.
  • Strong communication skills, including clear written updates, verbal communication, documentation, and actionable feedback.
  • Ability to interpret vague creative, design, or client direction and turn it into clear VFX tasks or implementation plans.
  • Experience mentoring, reviewing, or guiding other artists. A formal Lead title is not required, but leadership behaviors are important.
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and working with design, engineering, technical art, production, and art direction.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, organization, and problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
  • Houdini experience.
  • EmberGen experience.
  • Unity experience.
  • Substance Designer experience.
  • Experience with proprietary engines or custom VFX tools.
  • Scripting or coding skills, such as C#, Python, Blueprint, or similar.
  • 2D animation or traditional animation experience.
  • 3D animation, simulation, or procedural content creation experience.
  • Experience creating both stylized and realistic effects.
  • Experience with foliage, atmospherics, environmental effects, weather, destruction, or ambient world VFX.
  • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development teams, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience establishing VFX standards, templates, naming conventions, libraries, scalability rules, or pipeline documentation.
  • Experience supporting client reviews, milestone deliveries, or cross-studio feedback loops.
  • Experience leading a small pod, strike team, feature group, or informal group of artists.
  • English proficiency: B2 or higher required.
  • All applicants are required to submit their CVs in English as part of the application process.

Portfolio Requirements

  • Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your real-time VFX capabilities.
  • Your portfolio must include:
    • Real-time VFX assets with strong readability, timing, shape language, and clearly understandable visual elements.
    • At least one example shown in a real-time gameplay context, preferably a video of the effect happening in-game or during interactive gameplay.
    • Examples of strong material definition and texture work, with clean, readable, well-constructed setups.
    • Effects that demonstrate fundamentals such as composition, mood, color choices, timing, motion, impact, readability, and understanding of natural energies.
    • Examples of effects implemented in-engine, preferably in Unreal Engine 4 or 5 / Niagara.
    • Breakdowns showing your process, including textures, materials, emitters, timing, implementation, optimization, or technical setup where applicable.
    • Clear explanations of what you personally created, especially for any team-created work.
  • Strongly preferred portfolio examples include:
    • Before/after examples showing how you improved an effect through feedback, mentorship, optimization, or art direction.
    • A small set of effects that demonstrate consistent style, quality bar, or gameplay readability across a feature or content set.
    • Examples of templates, libraries, material systems, naming conventions, scalability setups, or pipeline improvements you helped create.
    • Examples that show how you balanced visual quality with performance constraints.

Please note: if your portfolio is mostly isolated effects in presentation scenes without runtime gameplay context, this may not be the right fit. We are looking for artists who understand how VFX function inside real-time gameplay, not just how they look in isolation.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

If working on some of the biggest and best titles with some of the coolest people within the games industry isn't enough, we also offer:

  • Work alongside dynamic individuals in the gaming industry
  • Work within a company with upward career growth opportunities
  • Work Fully Remote
  • Full Time Employment Benefits for applicants located in MX only include:
    • Comprehensive statutory benefits: social security, 12 days of annual leave, 30 days' Christmas bonus, and a 25% vacation premium.
    • After 3 months:
      • Major and minor medical insurance
      • Savings fund
      • Grocery vouchers ($1244.88 MXN)
  • Salary RANGE: 32k to 35k MXN gross per month

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides for equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at at .

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Informaticist works in the Process Insights team to analyze and provide quantitative insights from our AI Process Insights tools. They may coordinate with other analytics, IT and business areas across the organization to ensure work is completed with insights from knowledge SMEs. The Senior Informaticist work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Program Summary

The Simplification Center of Excellence (CoE) is building a new enterprise capability that helps teams create simpler, more effective, and more human‑centered solutions for associates, members, patients, and providers. Joining this team means contributing directly to how the organization understands work today and builds better experiences for the future.

The CoE develops shared tools, methods, and guidance that support teams from discovery through delivery—bringing together process insight, research, ideation, rapid prototyping, and impact assessment to improve both speed and quality of outcomes. By establishing these capabilities, the team enables more informed decisions, stronger solution design, and greater confidence in what gets built and delivered.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Informaticist to serve as a data and analytics expert within our process intelligence/mining program, working alongside a Program Manager. In this role you will contribute deep analytical expertise, translating complex process and operational data into clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.

You will leverage AI process mining tools such as Skan AI, and enterprise data sources to interpret how work is performed, identify meaningful patterns, and help define the metrics that matter most. Using tools such as Power BI and advanced visualization techniques, you will design, build, and continuously refine dashboards and infographics that make insights intuitive, compelling, and immediately usable by leaders and delivery teams. Your ability to combine quantitative analysis with strong visual storytelling will ensure data is not only accurate, but actionable.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and support the data strategy for each program that is onboarding to a task mining initiative.
  • Assess data readiness; identify source systems, event logs, and required data feeds for each program.
  • Interpret process, operational, and engagement data generated through task mining and related data sources to support insight generation for a single operational engagement.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards using Power BI, translating complex data into clear, intuitive views tailored to the needs of the pod and operational team.
  • Work collaboratively with the Program Manager and operational partners to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that reflect engagement goals and performance.
  • Apply creativity and visual storytelling techniques to experiment with infographics and alternative data visualizations, making insights easier to understand and act upon.
  • Analyze trends, patterns, and variances in data to surface opportunities, risks, and emerging signals relevant to the engagement.
  • Iterate on dashboards and visuals based on user feedback, changing engagement needs, and evolving questions, ensuring outputs remain relevant and actionable.
  • Clearly communicate analytical findings through concise narratives and visuals that support discussion, decision-making, and next steps within the pod.

Core Skills & Attributes

  • Data Interpretation & Analytical Thinking
    Strong ability to interpret complex process and operational data, identify patterns and trends, and translate findings into meaningful insights aligned to engagement goals.
  • Dashboard Design & Data Visualization
    Proven experience designing and modifying dashboards in Power BI, with an emphasis on clarity, usability, and visual storytelling rather than static reporting.
  • Creative Use of Infographics
    High level of creativity in experimenting with infographics and alternative visual formats to make data intuitive, engaging, and action‑oriented.
  • Metrics & KPI Development
    Experience working with stakeholders to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that support operational understanding and performance tracking.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
    Comfortable working closely with Program Managers and operational partners within a pod model, adapting analyses and outputs based on evolving questions and feedback.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling
    Ability to communicate insights clearly through concise narratives and visuals, tailoring messages to operational audiences with varying levels of data fluency.
  • Attention to Detail & Data Rigor
    Careful, methodical approach to data validation, consistency, and accuracy, balanced with the ability to move quickly in an engagement‑based environment.
  • Adaptability & Learning Mindset
    Thrives in a dynamic engagement setting, quickly learning new domains, adjusting analytical approaches, and iterating on outputs as needs evolve.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, informatics, business intelligence, or a related analytical discipline, with a focus on operational or process‑oriented data.
  • Hands‑on experience designing, building, and maintaining dashboards in Power BI, including the ability to modify and iterate on existing dashboards as engagement needs evolve.
  • Experience working with process, workflow, or engagement data (e.g., operational metrics, performance data, or AI‑generated process insights) to support analysis and decision‑making.
  • Demonstrated experience defining, refining, and analyzing key metrics and KPIs in partnership with operational or delivery teams.
  • Proven ability to use data visualization, infographics, and visual storytelling techniques to make insights clear, compelling, and actionable for non‑technical audiences.
  • Experience working in a collaborative, pod‑based or cross‑functional team model, partnering closely with program, product, or operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, balancing analytical rigor with flexibility, creativity, and responsiveness in an engagement‑driven environment.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$97,900 - $133,500 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Job Description:

The Triage Specialist supports a federal agency by receiving, reviewing, and directing incident reports to the appropriate point of contact. The Triage Specialist works as part of a small team of federal and contract staff to ensure inbox coverage 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays.

The schedule for this position will be Thursday - Monday or Saturday - Wednesday.


Position Duties:


  • Monitor a shared incident response inbox in collaboration with other team members to ensure timely response and incident elevation.
  • Analyze each incoming incident in accordance with federal policies to ensure incidents are documented correctly and routed to the appropriate point of contact.
  • Provide technical assistance in situations where incident reports need to be corrected and/or resubmitted in accordance with policy.
  • Create shift reports and complete other activities necessary to prepare team members to take over inbox coverage.
  • Catalog and file incidents in keeping with policies and standard operating procedures.
  • Maintain a tracking system for reported incidents and perform quality assurance to ensure data accuracy.
  • Perform data analysis to identify trends in incident reporting.
  • Provide reports on inbox activity on regular and as-needed bases.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a relevant field with at least 4 years of related experience.
  • Experience in case management, child welfare, or social work required.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and to collaborate with team members in a remote environment.
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Excel and performing basic data analysis preferred.

Additional Requirements:


  • Must be able and willing to work weekends and some holidays.
  • This position requires an existing Public Trust or the ability to obtain one.

raw.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $60K - $70K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
  • $70K - $80K CAD (Canada-based candidates)

We’re Not Looking for Employees. We’re Looking for Builders.Level is looking for a Designer who can take an idea, a brief, or a rough concept and turn it into creative that actually performs. If you love the craft of design and the discipline of data in equal measure, this is your seat.

This Isn't for Everyone

This role moves fast, and it moves often. You'll juggle multiple live projects, tight platform specs, and feedback loops that don't wait around. You'll take direction well, but you'll also be expected to catch problems before they become someone else's problem.

Ambiguity is part of the job. Briefs won't always be complete. Specs will change mid-project. You'll need to make smart calls, ask sharp questions, and keep moving without losing quality along the way.

This is a collaborative seat, not a solo one. You'll work alongside strategists, copywriters, art directors, and developers, and you'll need to take feedback from senior creative team members and turn it into stronger work, every time. If you want static ownership over one lane and no exposure to performance data, this isn't the right fit. If you want to build creative that gets measured, tested, and improved, and you want to get better at that process every single day, keep reading.

About Level

Level is a performance marketing agency built for brands that expect more. We combine strategy, creative, media, and AI into one system designed to turn insight into compounding growth, not one-off wins.

We're remote-first, which means we hire the best people wherever they are and build a culture around trust, clear communication, and real accountability. Our team spans the US and Canada, and we're united by a simple belief: good enough isn't. We move fast, we tell the truth, and we care about the outcomes our work actually drives for clients, not just the output we produce.

We're building a diverse, high-performing team of people who take ownership, push each other to improve, and genuinely enjoy doing great work together.

Your Role (and Impact)

As a Designer on Level's Creative team, you'll create digital-first visual content across formats, including paid ads, social content, landing pages, and email, that aligns with client brand standards and drives real business outcomes. You'll work both independently and collaboratively to concept, design, and deliver creative that's built to perform, using AI-assisted tools where they help you move faster, iterate smarter, or test more.

This is a multidisciplinary role. You'll move across design platforms and emerging creative technologies, and your work will directly shape how client campaigns land and how well they convert.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute visual design work from concept through final delivery across digital formats: paid ads, social, web, email, and display.
  • Design creative for major ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others) with a performance-first mindset.
  • Apply brand guidelines and creative best practices consistently across all assets.
  • Take projects from initial idea to completion, collaborating with creative strategists, copywriters, art directors, and developers.
  • Take direction and feedback from senior creative team members and apply it to your work.
  • Partner with client services, strategy, and media teams to make sure creative supports campaign goals from the start.
  • Support quick-turn requests, including resizing, editing, and asset clean-up.
  • Use data and feedback to refine designs after launch.
  • Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow for rapid concepting, image generation, content variations, and iteration.
  • Stay current on design trends, tools, AI capabilities, and platform updates.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Your creative holds up across every platform it touches. No scrambling to fix specs or brand misses after launch.
  • You're using performance data to make the next round of work better, not just producing and moving on.
  • You've built AI into your actual process. It shows up in your speed and iteration, not just as a checkbox.
  • You need less direction over time. Early on, you're leaning on senior feedback. Later, you're catching issues and making strong calls on your own.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3 to 4+ years of experience or equivalent education.
  • A strong portfolio showing digital ad design and branding work.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and how they fit into a design workflow.
  • Understanding of digital ad formats and platform best practices.
  • Knowledge of UX principles, responsive design, and accessibility.
  • Strong time management across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Digital marketing agency experience.
  • Basic video editing, animation, or motion graphics experience.

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a tool for thoughtful acceleration, not a replacement for judgment. You'll be expected to use AI tools as part of your everyday design process: rapid concepting, image generation, content variations, and iteration, so you can move faster and test more without sacrificing quality.

We want you experimenting with new tools and workflows as they emerge, and we want you staying sharp about where AI helps and where your own eye, taste, and strategic judgment matter most. You own the final creative decision every time, AI just helps you get there faster.

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In
    We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together.
  • Better Every Day
    We want the feedback—even when it stings.
  • Relentless for Results
    Activity is nothing without outcomes.
  • Driven by Truth
    We challenge assumptions and follow the data.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB). Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and celebrate what makes you, you—regardless of race, gender identity, age, disability status, sexual orientation, or background.

Ready to Apply?
Click below and submit your resume. You’ll also be asked a few thoughtful questions—take your time. We care more about your thinking than your pedigree.

Let’s build something together.

Télétravail — États-Unis et Canada seulement | Poste à temps plein

Rémunération :

  • 60 000 $ à 70 000 $ USD (candidats basés aux États-Unis)
  • 70 000 $ à 80 000 $ CAD (candidats basés au Canada)

Nous ne cherchons pas simplement des employés. Nous cherchons des bâtisseurs.

Level est à la recherche d'un ou d'une Designer capable de transformer une idée, un mandat ou un concept sommaire en créatif qui performe réellement. Si vous aimez le métier du design autant que la rigueur des données, ce poste est pour vous.

Ce poste n'est pas pour tout le monde

Ce rôle avance vite, et souvent. Vous jonglerez avec plusieurs projets actifs à la fois, des spécifications de plateformes serrées et des boucles de rétroaction qui n'attendent pas. Vous devrez bien recevoir les directives, mais on s'attendra aussi à ce que vous repériez les problèmes avant qu'ils deviennent celui de quelqu'un d'autre.

L'ambiguïté fait partie du travail. Les mandats ne seront pas toujours complets. Les spécifications changeront en cours de projet. Vous devrez faire preuve de jugement, poser les bonnes questions et continuer d'avancer sans sacrifier la qualité.

C'est un rôle collaboratif, pas un rôle en vase clos. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de stratèges, de rédacteurs, de directeurs artistiques et de développeurs, et vous devrez recevoir les commentaires des membres seniors de l'équipe créative et les transformer en travail encore plus solide, chaque fois. Si vous cherchez un rôle statique, limité à un seul volet et sans lien avec les données de performance, ce n'est pas le bon poste pour vous. Mais si vous voulez créer du contenu qui se mesure, se teste et s'améliore, et que vous voulez progresser dans ce processus chaque jour, continuez votre lecture.

À propos de Level

Level est une agence de marketing de performance conçue pour les marques qui visent plus haut. Nous combinons stratégie, créatif, médias et intelligence artificielle en un seul système pensé pour transformer les données en croissance durable, et non en victoires isolées.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur le télétravail, ce qui signifie que nous embauchons les meilleurs talents où qu'ils soient et que nous bâtissons notre culture autour de la confiance, d'une communication claire et d'une réelle imputabilité. Notre équipe est répartie aux États-Unis et au Canada, et nous partageons une conviction simple : le bon, ce n'est pas suffisant. Nous avançons rapidement, nous disons les choses telles qu'elles sont, et nous nous soucions vraiment des résultats que notre travail génère pour nos clients, pas seulement du volume de production.

Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée et hautement performante, formée de gens qui prennent les choses en main, qui se poussent mutuellement à s'améliorer et qui aiment sincèrement bien faire les choses ensemble.

Votre rôle (et son impact)

En tant que Designer au sein de l'équipe créative de Level, vous créerez du contenu visuel numérique dans plusieurs formats, notamment des publicités payantes, du contenu pour les réseaux sociaux, des pages de destination et des courriels, en respectant les normes de marque des clients et en générant de réels résultats d'affaires. Vous travaillerez à la fois de façon autonome et en collaboration pour concevoir, réaliser et livrer un créatif pensé pour performer, en utilisant des outils assistés par l'IA lorsqu'ils vous permettent d'avancer plus vite, d'itérer plus intelligemment ou de tester davantage.

C'est un rôle multidisciplinaire. Vous naviguerez entre différentes plateformes de conception et technologies créatives émergentes, et votre travail influencera directement la façon dont les campagnes clients performent et convertissent.

Ce que vous ferez :

  • Réaliser le travail de conception visuelle, du concept jusqu'à la livraison finale, dans divers formats numériques : publicités payantes, réseaux sociaux, web, courriel et affichage.
  • Concevoir du créatif pour les principales plateformes publicitaires (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn et autres) avec une approche axée sur la performance.
  • Appliquer les lignes directrices de marque et les meilleures pratiques créatives de façon constante sur tous les actifs.
  • Mener les projets de l'idée initiale jusqu'à leur réalisation, en collaboration avec les stratèges créatifs, rédacteurs, directeurs artistiques et développeurs.
  • Recevoir les directives et les commentaires des membres seniors de l'équipe créative et les appliquer à votre travail.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de service à la clientèle, de stratégie et de médias pour vous assurer que le créatif appuie les objectifs de campagne dès le départ.
  • Répondre aux demandes urgentes, notamment le redimensionnement, les modifications et le nettoyage d'actifs.
  • Utiliser les données et les commentaires pour raffiner les conceptions après le lancement.
  • Intégrer les outils d'IA à votre flux de travail quotidien pour l'idéation rapide, la génération d'images, les variations de contenu et l'itération.
  • Rester à l'affût des tendances en design, des outils, des capacités de l'IA et des mises à jour des plateformes.

À quoi ressemble le succès :

  • Votre créatif tient la route sur toutes les plateformes où il est déployé. Aucune course de dernière minute pour corriger des spécifications ou des écarts de marque après le lancement.
  • Vous utilisez les données de performance pour améliorer la prochaine ronde de travail, et non seulement pour produire et passer à autre chose.
  • Vous avez intégré l'IA à votre processus réel. Elle se reflète dans votre rapidité et votre itération, pas seulement comme une case à cocher.
  • Vous avez besoin de moins de supervision avec le temps. Au début, vous vous appuyez sur les commentaires des membres seniors. Plus tard, vous repérez vous-même les problèmes et prenez de bonnes décisions de façon autonome.

Exigences

Incontournables :

  • 3 à 4 ans d'expérience ou plus, ou une formation équivalente.
  • Un portfolio solide démontrant des réalisations en design publicitaire numérique et en image de marque.
  • Maîtrise de la suite Adobe Creative (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et de Figma.
  • Connaissance des outils d'IA et de leur intégration dans un flux de travail de design.
  • Compréhension des formats publicitaires numériques et des meilleures pratiques par plateforme.
  • Connaissance des principes UX, du design adaptatif et de l'accessibilité.
  • Excellente gestion du temps dans un contexte de projets multiples et simultanés.
  • Bonnes habiletés de communication et approche collaborative en équipe.

Atouts :

  • Expérience en agence de marketing numérique.
  • Expérience de base en montage vidéo, en animation ou en motion design.

Attentes en matière d'IA

Chez Level, l'IA est un outil d'accélération réfléchie, pas un substitut au jugement. Vous devrez intégrer les outils d'IA à votre processus de design quotidien : idéation rapide, génération d'images, variations de contenu et itération, afin d'avancer plus vite et de tester davantage sans compromettre la qualité.

Nous souhaitons que vous expérimentiez avec les nouveaux outils et flux de travail à mesure qu'ils émergent, tout en restant attentif ou attentive aux situations où l'IA aide réellement et à celles où votre œil, votre goût et votre jugement stratégique demeurent essentiels. La décision créative finale vous appartient toujours ; l'IA ne fait que vous aider à y arriver plus rapidement.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • Sans ego, tous engagés
    Il n’y a pas de « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble.
  • S’améliorer chaque jour
    Nous voulons la rétroaction — même quand elle est difficile à entendre.
  • Obsédés par les résultats
    L’activité seule ne suffit pas. Les résultats comptent.
  • Guidés par la vérité

raw.description:
Are you an experienced recruitment professional ready to take control of your career while backed by a global brand? Keller Haldren is seeking an ambitious, independent-minded recruiter to join our partner network in Denmark.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a talented recruiter who wants the autonomy of running their own operation while leveraging the infrastructure, brand recognition, and support of an established global recruitment organization.

As a Keller Haldren Partner, you will have the freedom to build and grow your own recruitment business, your way, while benefiting from:

  • Brand Power - Immediate credibility with clients and candidates through the Keller Haldren network.
  • Operational Support - Access to our proven systems, technology platforms, and back-office infrastructure
  • Global Network - Connect with fellow partners worldwide for cross-border placements and knowledge sharing
  • Marketing Resources - Professional marketing materials, digital assets, and campaign support tailored for your market
  • Financial Flexibility - Competitive revenue share model with transparent fee structure designed for your market, allowing you to retain significant earnings while accessing enterprise-level resources

The Ideal Partner Profile

You are an established recruitment professional who:

  • Has 5-10 years of proven recruitment experience with a track record of successful placements and client relationships in your local market.
  • Is ready for independence - You have been thinking about starting your own operation but want the backing of an established brand
  • OR has recently launched an independent recruitment business and seeks strategic partnership to accelerate growth
  • Possesses strong industry networks and the ability to generate business through existing relationships
  • Values collaboration while maintaining entrepreneurial drive
  • Understands market dynamics, cultural nuances, and regulatory environment
  • Has the ambition to build a sustainable, profitable recruitment operation

About Keller Haldren

Keller Haldren is a global executive search and recruitment firm with operations across multiple countries. We specialize in connecting exceptional talent with leading organizations and have built a reputation for quality, integrity, and results.

Our partner model has been developed to empower talented recruiters to build their own businesses while benefiting from our established infrastructure, brand, and global network. We believe that the best recruitment businesses are built by passionate professionals who have the freedom to operate autonomously while supported by world-class resources.

Requirements

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years recruitment experience
  • Demonstrated ability to manage full recruitment lifecycle independently
  • Strong client relationship management skills
  • Self-starter mentality with business development capabilities
  • Strong understanding of employment law and recruitment practices
  • Excellent communication skills (fluency in English essential)

Desirable

  • Existing client base or business pipeline
  • Specialization in high-demand sectors
  • Experience with recruitment technology and CRM systems
  • Previous experience running a business or managing P&L
  • Established network within your business community

Benefits

Build Your Business, With Enterprise-Level Backing

Enjoy complete operational autonomy while leveraging the credibility of an established global brand. As a true business partner, you'll earn 100% commission-based income through our transparent revenue share model; keeping the majority of what you generate, with no salary cap limiting your potential.

Access proven technology platforms, back-office infrastructure, and professional marketing resources without the bureaucracy. Connect with our global partner network for cross-border opportunities and knowledge sharing.

Legal & Compliance

  • We evaluate applicants solely on qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination based on gender, age, disability, race/ethnic origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression/characteristics, or any other ground protected under Danish law.
  • If you need a reasonable accommodation during our process, please contact us so that we can arrange appropriate measures.
  • Keller Haldren never charges jobseekers any fees. Client companies pay our professional fees.
  • Controller(s): Keller Haldren and, if appointed, the authorized local partner act as separate controllers for applications received by each. Purpose: evaluating your application and partner onboarding. Legal bases: GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)/(f) and, if relevant, Art. 9(2) exemptions. Retention: applications are kept no longer than necessary; where needed to document the recruitment, up to 3 years for unsuccessful applicants; otherwise deleted sooner or retained with your consent for a talent pool. Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, complaint to Datatilsynet. Read more:
  • We host recruitment data in the EU where possible. Where data is transferred outside the EU/EEA (e.g., selected vendors), we use GDPR Chapter V safeguards such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • This opportunity is commission-only via a revenue-share. We will provide applicants with clear information about the commission structure and typical ranges on request, and we will update disclosures in line with Denmark’s implementation of the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
  • This is an independent authorized partner opportunity with Keller Haldren, not employment with a Danish entity; no Danish payroll or employee benefits are offered.

As a Lead Substation Protection & Controls Engineer, you’ll own complex P&C designs across 12–500 kV systems, applying advanced digital logic and AC/DC circuit expertise to engineer solutions that protect the modern grid and enable renewable integration. If you’re ready for high‑voltage challenges and high‑visibility impact, this is your next step.

  • Create and refine relay one‑line diagrams that define protection zones and system topology.
  • Develop detailed AC schematics that capture current, voltage, and protection device relationships.
  • Produce DC control and protection schematics that ensure safe and reliable operation of substation equipment.
  • Design control panels, wiring diagrams, and physical layouts that support efficient construction and long‑term maintainability.
  • Build accurate BOMs aligned with project criteria, equipment standards, and client requirements.
  • Perform rigorous QC checks on wiring and schematic designs to ensure accuracy, safety, and constructability.
  • Contribute from early scoping through final design, implementation, and energization support.
  • Provide technical guidance during installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Apply National Electrical Safety Code requirements to ensure safe and compliant designs.

Successful candidates must comply with quality control and safe work practices and maintain compliance with project scope, schedule, and budget. This position will be a member of a design team comprised of engineers, designers, and CAD technicians and will work with client standards to implement design.

  • Senior Level: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or related degree with eight (4+) or more years of substation protection control design experience.

  • Experience in leading and executing substation protection and control projects.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal teams and clients to support project needs.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and stay organized in fast‑paced or high‑pressure situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment, contribute to group success, and provide leadership when needed.
  • Self‑starter who can take initiative and work with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical abilities with a track record of solving engineering challenges both independently and collaboratively.
  • High level of computer competency and comfort working with engineering tools and software.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites and client locations as needed.

  • Engineer Intern (“EI” or “EIT”) professional certification.

  • Master’s degree in related field.
  • Field testing/commissioning experience.

Our recognition as an industry leader is confirmed by the latest national rankings by Engineering News-Record (ENR) ranking Leidos within the Top 10 T&D Firms, and Top 10 Power Firms. To explore and learn more, click here!

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

We take care of our employees. We challenge you to help solve some of the world’s toughest problems, and reward you with a welcoming culture that recognizes the importance of a strong work/life balance, as well as competitive compensation and benefits. We believe that diversity and inclusion make us all better and offer the chance to have fun and make a difference.

raw.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

The Leidos Energy, Infrastructure, and Automation (EIA) operation helps solve utilities’ complex challenges through our full life-cycle, performance-based solutions. Our services include engineering, planning, project management, construction management, and commissioning for electric power substations and transmission and distribution lines; protection and controls design; and electrification programs. Utilities consistently come to Leidos for reliable power expertise, as reflected through our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and more than 100 municipals/cooperatives across the country as well as a growing number of private developers.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos' EIA business area is seeking a Senior Growth Solutions Architect to drive growth in the Electric Power Utilities market by delivering AI-enabled, grid modernization solutions. This role blends strategic sales, solution architecture, AI-enabled growth strategies, and deep utility domain expertise to help clients transform transmission, substation, and distribution design and operations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to utility executives and partner to our Growth team, shaping large-scale opportunities and delivering innovative solutions that improve grid reliability, resilience, and performance while aligning closely to customer priorities, regulatory realities, and operational challenges.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop deep understanding in partnership with development and product management of our AI-enabled technologies, strategies, and value propositions with a focus on how they address real-world utility challenges and customer outcomes.
  • Develop go-to-market materials and aid the Growth team in expanding their understanding, messaging, client engagement, and opportunity development.
  • Demonstrate active listening and on-the-fly adaptation to understand customer frictions and refine our value propositions to ease friction and bolster benefits.
  • Serve as an active agent in learning derivative market challenges and being the voice of the customer’s most strategic challenges within the development and investment organization ensuring solutions are shaped by real customer needs, not just technical possibilities.
  • Leverage the modern portfolio of AI tooling to better understand markets, customers, budgets, and mission frictions with an emphasis on generating actionable insights that support customer alignment and decision-making.
  • Shape the future of the AI-driven, resilient electric grid, lead high-value, strategic deals with top utilities, and deliver solutions that enable energy transition, reliability, and sustainability.
  • Build C-level relationships (CIO, CTO, COO, and T&D executive leaders).

AI & Grid Innovation Focus:

  • Building the grid of the future requires a deep understanding of operational, regulatory, and economic realities across utilities, AI serves as an enabler to better anticipate, optimize, and respond to these challenges.
  • Maintain a relentless focus on customer pain points across transmission, substation, and distribution, developing a nuanced understanding of how constraints impact reliability, workforce efficiency, capital planning, and customer outcomes.
  • Apply AI as a tool to enhance decision-making, uncover patterns in operational and market behavior, and translate complex data into actionable insights and alignment.
  • Partner closely with customers to apply innovative approaches that align with their strategic priorities, rather than leading with technology-first solutions.
  • Stay deeply attuned to evolving industry trends (grid resilience, electrification, DER growth, microgrids, regulatory shifts) and continuously refine how innovation can deliver measurable business and operational value.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • 12 plus years in Electric Power Utilities (T&D, grid operations, or design).
  • Proven success by closing large, complex deals and managing strategic portfolios.
  • Strong expertise in utility systems (planning, design, operations).
  • Experience in solution architecture, systems integration, and digital transformation.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, cyber, and cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) concepts.
  • Deep grid domain expertise and understanding of utility operations.
  • Ability to translate emerging technologies into business value.
  • Strong business development and solution selling skills.
  • Executive presence with strong client engagement and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to lead high-performing, cross-functional teams.
  • Innate curiosity and problem statement development skills.

Favorable if you have:

  • Experience with T&D grid design and modernization, DER integration, and NERC CIP compliance.
  • Background in real-time systems, industrial networks, or utility OT environments.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Are you an experienced recruitment professional ready to take control of your career while backed by a global brand? Keller Haldren is seeking an ambitious, independent-minded recruiter to join our partner network in Poland.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a talented recruiter who wants the autonomy of running their own operation while leveraging the infrastructure, brand recognition, and support of an established global recruitment organization.

As a Keller Haldren Partner, you will have the freedom to build and grow your own recruitment business, your way, while benefiting from:

  • Brand Power - Immediate credibility with clients and candidates through the Keller Haldren network.
  • Operational Support - Access to our proven systems, technology platforms, and back-office infrastructure

  • Marketing Resources - Professional marketing materials, digital assets, and campaign support tailored for your market
  • Financial Flexibility - Competitive revenue share model with transparent fee structure designed for your market, allowing you to retain significant earnings while accessing enterprise-level resources

The Ideal Partner Profile

You are an established recruitment professional who:

  • Has 5-10 years of proven recruitment experience with a track record of successful placements and client relationships in your local market.
  • Is ready for independence - You have been thinking about starting your own operation but want the backing of an established brand

  • Values collaboration while maintaining entrepreneurial drive

  • Has the ambition to build a sustainable, profitable recruitment operation

About Keller Haldren

Keller Haldren is a global executive search and recruitment firm with operations across multiple countries. We specialize in connecting exceptional talent with leading organizations and have built a reputation for quality, integrity, and results.

Our partner model has been developed to empower talented recruiters to build their own businesses while benefiting from our established infrastructure, brand, and global network. We believe that the best recruitment businesses are built by passionate professionals who have the freedom to operate autonomously while supported by world-class resources.

Requirements

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years recruitment experience
  • Demonstrated ability to manage full recruitment lifecycle independently
  • Strong client relationship management skills
  • Self-starter mentality with business development capabilities
  • Strong understanding of employment law and recruitment practices

Desirable

  • Existing client base or business pipeline
  • Specialization in high-demand sectors
  • Experience with recruitment technology and CRM systems
  • Previous experience running a business or managing P&L
  • Established network within your business community

Benefits

Build Your Business, With Enterprise-Level Backing

Enjoy complete operational autonomy while leveraging the credibility of an established global brand. As a true business partner, you'll earn 100% commission-based income through our transparent revenue share model; keeping the majority of what you generate, with no salary cap limiting your potential.

Access proven technology platforms, back-office infrastructure, and professional marketing resources without the bureaucracy. Connect with our global partner network for cross-border opportunities and knowledge sharing.

Legal basis: legitimate interests (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)) and/or steps prior to contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). Retention: normally up to 12 months (longer only with your consent or where required by law). Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and complaint to a supervisory authority. More info:
