raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Informaticist works in the Process Insights team to analyze and provide quantitative insights from our AI Process Insights tools. They may coordinate with other analytics, IT and business areas across the organization to ensure work is completed with insights from knowledge SMEs. The Senior Informaticist work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Program Summary

The Simplification Center of Excellence (CoE) is building a new enterprise capability that helps teams create simpler, more effective, and more human‑centered solutions for associates, members, patients, and providers. Joining this team means contributing directly to how the organization understands work today and builds better experiences for the future.

The CoE develops shared tools, methods, and guidance that support teams from discovery through delivery—bringing together process insight, research, ideation, rapid prototyping, and impact assessment to improve both speed and quality of outcomes. By establishing these capabilities, the team enables more informed decisions, stronger solution design, and greater confidence in what gets built and delivered.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Informaticist to serve as a data and analytics expert within our process intelligence/mining program, working alongside a Program Manager. In this role you will contribute deep analytical expertise, translating complex process and operational data into clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.

You will leverage AI process mining tools such as Skan AI, and enterprise data sources to interpret how work is performed, identify meaningful patterns, and help define the metrics that matter most. Using tools such as Power BI and advanced visualization techniques, you will design, build, and continuously refine dashboards and infographics that make insights intuitive, compelling, and immediately usable by leaders and delivery teams. Your ability to combine quantitative analysis with strong visual storytelling will ensure data is not only accurate, but actionable.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and support the data strategy for each program that is onboarding to a task mining initiative.
  • Assess data readiness; identify source systems, event logs, and required data feeds for each program.
  • Interpret process, operational, and engagement data generated through task mining and related data sources to support insight generation for a single operational engagement.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards using Power BI, translating complex data into clear, intuitive views tailored to the needs of the pod and operational team.
  • Work collaboratively with the Program Manager and operational partners to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that reflect engagement goals and performance.
  • Apply creativity and visual storytelling techniques to experiment with infographics and alternative data visualizations, making insights easier to understand and act upon.
  • Analyze trends, patterns, and variances in data to surface opportunities, risks, and emerging signals relevant to the engagement.
  • Iterate on dashboards and visuals based on user feedback, changing engagement needs, and evolving questions, ensuring outputs remain relevant and actionable.
  • Clearly communicate analytical findings through concise narratives and visuals that support discussion, decision-making, and next steps within the pod.

Core Skills & Attributes

  • Data Interpretation & Analytical Thinking
    Strong ability to interpret complex process and operational data, identify patterns and trends, and translate findings into meaningful insights aligned to engagement goals.
  • Dashboard Design & Data Visualization
    Proven experience designing and modifying dashboards in Power BI, with an emphasis on clarity, usability, and visual storytelling rather than static reporting.
  • Creative Use of Infographics
    High level of creativity in experimenting with infographics and alternative visual formats to make data intuitive, engaging, and action‑oriented.
  • Metrics & KPI Development
    Experience working with stakeholders to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that support operational understanding and performance tracking.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
    Comfortable working closely with Program Managers and operational partners within a pod model, adapting analyses and outputs based on evolving questions and feedback.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling
    Ability to communicate insights clearly through concise narratives and visuals, tailoring messages to operational audiences with varying levels of data fluency.
  • Attention to Detail & Data Rigor
    Careful, methodical approach to data validation, consistency, and accuracy, balanced with the ability to move quickly in an engagement‑based environment.
  • Adaptability & Learning Mindset
    Thrives in a dynamic engagement setting, quickly learning new domains, adjusting analytical approaches, and iterating on outputs as needs evolve.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, informatics, business intelligence, or a related analytical discipline, with a focus on operational or process‑oriented data.
  • Hands‑on experience designing, building, and maintaining dashboards in Power BI, including the ability to modify and iterate on existing dashboards as engagement needs evolve.
  • Experience working with process, workflow, or engagement data (e.g., operational metrics, performance data, or AI‑generated process insights) to support analysis and decision‑making.
  • Demonstrated experience defining, refining, and analyzing key metrics and KPIs in partnership with operational or delivery teams.
  • Proven ability to use data visualization, infographics, and visual storytelling techniques to make insights clear, compelling, and actionable for non‑technical audiences.
  • Experience working in a collaborative, pod‑based or cross‑functional team model, partnering closely with program, product, or operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, balancing analytical rigor with flexibility, creativity, and responsiveness in an engagement‑driven environment.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$97,900 - $133,500 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

raw.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $60K - $70K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
  • $70K - $80K CAD (Canada-based candidates)

We’re Not Looking for Employees. We’re Looking for Builders.Level is looking for a Designer who can take an idea, a brief, or a rough concept and turn it into creative that actually performs. If you love the craft of design and the discipline of data in equal measure, this is your seat.

This Isn't for Everyone

This role moves fast, and it moves often. You'll juggle multiple live projects, tight platform specs, and feedback loops that don't wait around. You'll take direction well, but you'll also be expected to catch problems before they become someone else's problem.

Ambiguity is part of the job. Briefs won't always be complete. Specs will change mid-project. You'll need to make smart calls, ask sharp questions, and keep moving without losing quality along the way.

This is a collaborative seat, not a solo one. You'll work alongside strategists, copywriters, art directors, and developers, and you'll need to take feedback from senior creative team members and turn it into stronger work, every time. If you want static ownership over one lane and no exposure to performance data, this isn't the right fit. If you want to build creative that gets measured, tested, and improved, and you want to get better at that process every single day, keep reading.

About Level

Level is a performance marketing agency built for brands that expect more. We combine strategy, creative, media, and AI into one system designed to turn insight into compounding growth, not one-off wins.

We're remote-first, which means we hire the best people wherever they are and build a culture around trust, clear communication, and real accountability. Our team spans the US and Canada, and we're united by a simple belief: good enough isn't. We move fast, we tell the truth, and we care about the outcomes our work actually drives for clients, not just the output we produce.

We're building a diverse, high-performing team of people who take ownership, push each other to improve, and genuinely enjoy doing great work together.

Your Role (and Impact)

As a Designer on Level's Creative team, you'll create digital-first visual content across formats, including paid ads, social content, landing pages, and email, that aligns with client brand standards and drives real business outcomes. You'll work both independently and collaboratively to concept, design, and deliver creative that's built to perform, using AI-assisted tools where they help you move faster, iterate smarter, or test more.

This is a multidisciplinary role. You'll move across design platforms and emerging creative technologies, and your work will directly shape how client campaigns land and how well they convert.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute visual design work from concept through final delivery across digital formats: paid ads, social, web, email, and display.
  • Design creative for major ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others) with a performance-first mindset.
  • Apply brand guidelines and creative best practices consistently across all assets.
  • Take projects from initial idea to completion, collaborating with creative strategists, copywriters, art directors, and developers.
  • Take direction and feedback from senior creative team members and apply it to your work.
  • Partner with client services, strategy, and media teams to make sure creative supports campaign goals from the start.
  • Support quick-turn requests, including resizing, editing, and asset clean-up.
  • Use data and feedback to refine designs after launch.
  • Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow for rapid concepting, image generation, content variations, and iteration.
  • Stay current on design trends, tools, AI capabilities, and platform updates.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Your creative holds up across every platform it touches. No scrambling to fix specs or brand misses after launch.
  • You're using performance data to make the next round of work better, not just producing and moving on.
  • You've built AI into your actual process. It shows up in your speed and iteration, not just as a checkbox.
  • You need less direction over time. Early on, you're leaning on senior feedback. Later, you're catching issues and making strong calls on your own.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3 to 4+ years of experience or equivalent education.
  • A strong portfolio showing digital ad design and branding work.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and how they fit into a design workflow.
  • Understanding of digital ad formats and platform best practices.
  • Knowledge of UX principles, responsive design, and accessibility.
  • Strong time management across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Digital marketing agency experience.
  • Basic video editing, animation, or motion graphics experience.

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a tool for thoughtful acceleration, not a replacement for judgment. You'll be expected to use AI tools as part of your everyday design process: rapid concepting, image generation, content variations, and iteration, so you can move faster and test more without sacrificing quality.

We want you experimenting with new tools and workflows as they emerge, and we want you staying sharp about where AI helps and where your own eye, taste, and strategic judgment matter most. You own the final creative decision every time, AI just helps you get there faster.

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In
    We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together.
  • Better Every Day
    We want the feedback—even when it stings.
  • Relentless for Results
    Activity is nothing without outcomes.
  • Driven by Truth
    We challenge assumptions and follow the data.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB). Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and celebrate what makes you, you—regardless of race, gender identity, age, disability status, sexual orientation, or background.

Ready to Apply?
Click below and submit your resume. You’ll also be asked a few thoughtful questions—take your time. We care more about your thinking than your pedigree.

Let’s build something together.

Télétravail — États-Unis et Canada seulement | Poste à temps plein

Rémunération :

  • 60 000 $ à 70 000 $ USD (candidats basés aux États-Unis)
  • 70 000 $ à 80 000 $ CAD (candidats basés au Canada)

Nous ne cherchons pas simplement des employés. Nous cherchons des bâtisseurs.

Level est à la recherche d'un ou d'une Designer capable de transformer une idée, un mandat ou un concept sommaire en créatif qui performe réellement. Si vous aimez le métier du design autant que la rigueur des données, ce poste est pour vous.

Ce poste n'est pas pour tout le monde

Ce rôle avance vite, et souvent. Vous jonglerez avec plusieurs projets actifs à la fois, des spécifications de plateformes serrées et des boucles de rétroaction qui n'attendent pas. Vous devrez bien recevoir les directives, mais on s'attendra aussi à ce que vous repériez les problèmes avant qu'ils deviennent celui de quelqu'un d'autre.

L'ambiguïté fait partie du travail. Les mandats ne seront pas toujours complets. Les spécifications changeront en cours de projet. Vous devrez faire preuve de jugement, poser les bonnes questions et continuer d'avancer sans sacrifier la qualité.

C'est un rôle collaboratif, pas un rôle en vase clos. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de stratèges, de rédacteurs, de directeurs artistiques et de développeurs, et vous devrez recevoir les commentaires des membres seniors de l'équipe créative et les transformer en travail encore plus solide, chaque fois. Si vous cherchez un rôle statique, limité à un seul volet et sans lien avec les données de performance, ce n'est pas le bon poste pour vous. Mais si vous voulez créer du contenu qui se mesure, se teste et s'améliore, et que vous voulez progresser dans ce processus chaque jour, continuez votre lecture.

À propos de Level

Level est une agence de marketing de performance conçue pour les marques qui visent plus haut. Nous combinons stratégie, créatif, médias et intelligence artificielle en un seul système pensé pour transformer les données en croissance durable, et non en victoires isolées.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur le télétravail, ce qui signifie que nous embauchons les meilleurs talents où qu'ils soient et que nous bâtissons notre culture autour de la confiance, d'une communication claire et d'une réelle imputabilité. Notre équipe est répartie aux États-Unis et au Canada, et nous partageons une conviction simple : le bon, ce n'est pas suffisant. Nous avançons rapidement, nous disons les choses telles qu'elles sont, et nous nous soucions vraiment des résultats que notre travail génère pour nos clients, pas seulement du volume de production.

Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée et hautement performante, formée de gens qui prennent les choses en main, qui se poussent mutuellement à s'améliorer et qui aiment sincèrement bien faire les choses ensemble.

Votre rôle (et son impact)

En tant que Designer au sein de l'équipe créative de Level, vous créerez du contenu visuel numérique dans plusieurs formats, notamment des publicités payantes, du contenu pour les réseaux sociaux, des pages de destination et des courriels, en respectant les normes de marque des clients et en générant de réels résultats d'affaires. Vous travaillerez à la fois de façon autonome et en collaboration pour concevoir, réaliser et livrer un créatif pensé pour performer, en utilisant des outils assistés par l'IA lorsqu'ils vous permettent d'avancer plus vite, d'itérer plus intelligemment ou de tester davantage.

C'est un rôle multidisciplinaire. Vous naviguerez entre différentes plateformes de conception et technologies créatives émergentes, et votre travail influencera directement la façon dont les campagnes clients performent et convertissent.

Ce que vous ferez :

  • Réaliser le travail de conception visuelle, du concept jusqu'à la livraison finale, dans divers formats numériques : publicités payantes, réseaux sociaux, web, courriel et affichage.
  • Concevoir du créatif pour les principales plateformes publicitaires (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn et autres) avec une approche axée sur la performance.
  • Appliquer les lignes directrices de marque et les meilleures pratiques créatives de façon constante sur tous les actifs.
  • Mener les projets de l'idée initiale jusqu'à leur réalisation, en collaboration avec les stratèges créatifs, rédacteurs, directeurs artistiques et développeurs.
  • Recevoir les directives et les commentaires des membres seniors de l'équipe créative et les appliquer à votre travail.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de service à la clientèle, de stratégie et de médias pour vous assurer que le créatif appuie les objectifs de campagne dès le départ.
  • Répondre aux demandes urgentes, notamment le redimensionnement, les modifications et le nettoyage d'actifs.
  • Utiliser les données et les commentaires pour raffiner les conceptions après le lancement.
  • Intégrer les outils d'IA à votre flux de travail quotidien pour l'idéation rapide, la génération d'images, les variations de contenu et l'itération.
  • Rester à l'affût des tendances en design, des outils, des capacités de l'IA et des mises à jour des plateformes.

À quoi ressemble le succès :

  • Votre créatif tient la route sur toutes les plateformes où il est déployé. Aucune course de dernière minute pour corriger des spécifications ou des écarts de marque après le lancement.
  • Vous utilisez les données de performance pour améliorer la prochaine ronde de travail, et non seulement pour produire et passer à autre chose.
  • Vous avez intégré l'IA à votre processus réel. Elle se reflète dans votre rapidité et votre itération, pas seulement comme une case à cocher.
  • Vous avez besoin de moins de supervision avec le temps. Au début, vous vous appuyez sur les commentaires des membres seniors. Plus tard, vous repérez vous-même les problèmes et prenez de bonnes décisions de façon autonome.

Exigences

Incontournables :

  • 3 à 4 ans d'expérience ou plus, ou une formation équivalente.
  • Un portfolio solide démontrant des réalisations en design publicitaire numérique et en image de marque.
  • Maîtrise de la suite Adobe Creative (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et de Figma.
  • Connaissance des outils d'IA et de leur intégration dans un flux de travail de design.
  • Compréhension des formats publicitaires numériques et des meilleures pratiques par plateforme.
  • Connaissance des principes UX, du design adaptatif et de l'accessibilité.
  • Excellente gestion du temps dans un contexte de projets multiples et simultanés.
  • Bonnes habiletés de communication et approche collaborative en équipe.

Atouts :

  • Expérience en agence de marketing numérique.
  • Expérience de base en montage vidéo, en animation ou en motion design.

Attentes en matière d'IA

Chez Level, l'IA est un outil d'accélération réfléchie, pas un substitut au jugement. Vous devrez intégrer les outils d'IA à votre processus de design quotidien : idéation rapide, génération d'images, variations de contenu et itération, afin d'avancer plus vite et de tester davantage sans compromettre la qualité.

Nous souhaitons que vous expérimentiez avec les nouveaux outils et flux de travail à mesure qu'ils émergent, tout en restant attentif ou attentive aux situations où l'IA aide réellement et à celles où votre œil, votre goût et votre jugement stratégique demeurent essentiels. La décision créative finale vous appartient toujours ; l'IA ne fait que vous aider à y arriver plus rapidement.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • Sans ego, tous engagés
    Il n’y a pas de « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble.
  • S’améliorer chaque jour
    Nous voulons la rétroaction — même quand elle est difficile à entendre.
  • Obsédés par les résultats
    L’activité seule ne suffit pas. Les résultats comptent.
  • Guidés par la vérité
    Nous remettons les hypothèses en question et suivons les données.

Avantages et bénéfices

Chez Level, nous soutenons nos équipes aux États-Unis et au Canada avec des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet aux États-Unis et au Canada, allocation mensuelle pour le bureau à domicile et vendredis d’été
  • Congés généreux, incluant congés illimités (États-Unis), vacances compétitives (Canada) et options de congé parental et familial
  • Avantages sociaux complets, soutien en santé mentale et assurances invalidité et vie payées par l’entreprise
  • Contributions de l’employeur à la retraite (401(k) aux États-Unis, contribution équivalente au REER au Canada)
  • Évaluations de performance trimestrielles et occasions d’avancement professionnel

Télétravail d’abord

Ce poste est ouvert aux résidents des États-Unis et du Canada. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer des visas pour le moment.

Level est fondé sur l’inclusion

Nous sommes engagés envers la diversité, l’équité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance (DEIB). Level est fier d’être un employeur offrant l’égalité des chances — nous célébrons ce qui vous rend unique.

Prêt·e à postuler?

raw.title: Lead Transmission Line Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Lead Transmission Line Engineer who will manage a collaborative and dynamic team working in a fast-paced environment, solving challenging problems involved with electric transmission.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Lead Transmission Line Engineer who will manage a collaborative and dynamic team working in a fast-paced environment, solving challenging problems involved with electric transmission. The successful candidate will serve as a Lead Engineer and Technical Project Manager on high voltage electric transmission line design projects of overhead and underground systems for some of the largest utilities in the country as well as regional utilities. The candidate will apply NESC, ASCE, ACI, NEC, and other applicable standards in the engineering and design of all types of capital and maintenance projects from 34.5 kV to 765 kV.

Additionally, the candidate will direct a team of engineers that regularly perform engineering analyses, PLS-CADD modeling, structure loading calculations, foundation design using MFAD and/or LPILE, design structure framing and hardware assemblies, draft plans and specifications, and prepare bill of materials and procurement documents across project planning, engineering, environmental, permitting, and construction management phases.

The successful candidate can expect a fast-paced, diverse work environment and flexible work hours/work arrangements as well as a manager and peers who will encourage career development and growth! In addition, the successful candidate will be involved in applying AI, automation, and digital design platforms to streamline grid modernization and increase design efficiency.

This is a senior leadership role with primary responsibilities in client relations, staff management, proposal development, scope creation/change, project execution, and new business capture for the team’s full book of work. The successful candidate will be able to communicate clear expectations, goals, and vision; manage the performance of direct reports; motivate, coach, and mentor skilled professionals; and appropriately delegate project work. The candidate must be capable of managing collaboration and a positive team culture to achieve successful results.

The Challenge:

  • Direct multiple design teams simultaneously executing various projects and programs for multiple clients.
  • Develop a team of engineers by training, coaching, and nurturing Leidos’ engineering talent.
  • Supervise staff by approving timesheets and running the annual performance review process.
  • Participate proactively as a member of the leadership team of the Transmission Line Section.
  • Create responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs from clients for new work, including proposal creation and definition of scope of work.
  • Possess a growth mindset to foster creative problem solving for our clients’ most complex issues.
  • Promote continuous improvement to develop streamlined processes and tools that facilitate improvements to departmental technical resources via innovation and automation.
  • Delegate tasks to staff, forecast and plan their future workload, and run recruiting activities to support aggressive growth goals.
  • Drive the quality control process for the execution team to ensure the highest level of quality in all deliverables.
  • Liaise with clients to maximize affinity, facilitate business development growth, and foster long-term relationship building.
  • Manage portfolio health by leveraging Project Managers to independently drive and monitor scope, schedule, and budget. Accountability for schedule compliance requires high awareness and support from assigned Lead Engineers.

What Sets You Apart (Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering; Civil Engineering is preferred
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in the design of electric utility transmission systems with a Bachelor’s degree, or 6+ years of such experience with a Master's
  • Expertise in PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE
  • Engineer In Training (EIT) certification
  • Work effectively in a team environment; can also work independently
  • Track record of outstanding communication to serve as primary point of contact for existing and perspective clients
  • Business acumen with a record of understanding and meeting key project performance metrics
  • Working onsite in a Leidos or client office is a possibility; some periodic travel may be required
  • Ability and passion to develop staff through mentoring

Favorable If You Have:

  • Two plus (2+) years of supervising staff
  • Master's degree in Structural Engineering
  • Experience with TOWER
  • P.E. certification or the ability to achieve P.E Certification in 6 months
  • Experience with LPILE or FAD, Mathcad, AutoCAD or MicroStation, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) is a plus

Work Location: Ideally, candidate is located in either Portland, OR, or Seattle, WA. However, any candidate located in the Pacific Northwest will be considered for REMOTE work. Relocation assistance to Portland may be available for qualified candidates.

Why Leidos:

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

We take care of our employees. Leidos seeks the best and the brightest, and in return, we invest in you, with an eye on your future, through career advancement, growth opportunities, and continuous improvement via mentoring, formal and informal project management training and assistance with obtaining pertinent certifications. We challenge you to help solve some of the world’s toughest problems, and reward you with a welcoming culture that recognizes the importance of a strong work/life balance, as well as competitive compensation and benefits. We believe that diversity and inclusion make us all better and offer the chance to have fun and make a difference.

We value and support the well-being and mobility of our employees with competitive benefit packages, complementary e-learning training, work-life flexibility, an exciting External Referral Program, and a diverse, inclusive, and ethical workplace. Our recognition as an industry leader is confirmed by the latest national rankings by Engineering News-Record (ENR) ranking Leidos within the Top 10 T&D Firms, and Top 10 Power Firms.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading! Are you ready to make an impact? Begin your journey of a flourishing and meaningful career; share your resume with us today!

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

raw.title: Strategic Content Editor (Contract-to-Hire)
raw.excerpt: The situation, honestlyOur content department head is going on a planned leave in the near future.
raw.description:
The situation, honestly

Our content department head is going on a planned leave in the near future. Before that happens, we need a senior editor in place who can hold the line on strategy and quality while she's out, then keep raising the bar when she's back.

This starts as a contract role with a clear path to a full-time hire based on performance. We're not being coy about it: the leave is the reason for the speed, and the contract period is a working trial on both sides. If you do well, there's a permanent senior seat here with a benefits package.

Because of that timeline, we need someone who can ramp fast and operate independently. You'll get a real onboarding, documented strategy, and a team that knows what it's doing. You will not get six months to find your footing.

Who we are

RGX is a digital marketing agency built for home service businesses: HVAC, pest control, plumbing, electrical, and the trades that keep homes running.

Our clients are not hobby businesses. They’re doing $1.5M+ in annual revenue, investing in growth.

We help serious service businesses get clearer about what they offer, sharper about who they serve, and more direct about why a customer should choose them. Strategy first. Every sentence accountable to the business it serves.

What you'll actually do

  • Review strategy before content exists. You'll read content briefs, keyword strategies, and funnel plans before writing starts, and pressure-test them. If the targeting is off, the search intent is misread, or the funnel logic doesn't hold, you catch it at the brief stage, not the draft stage.
  • Edit for strategic alignment. Every draft gets checked against the strategy it was written to serve. You'll verify the copy matches the persona, the CTA fits the funnel stage, and the content actually satisfies the search intent we're targeting.
  • Create editing standards where they don't exist. If you notice a recurring writing problem, a missing tone of voice guide, or a gap in our editorial process, you build the fix. You don't wait to be asked, and you don't file it as someone else's problem. You do pause long enough to get leadership and team buy-in, because a standard only works if the people using it helped shape it. Fix what's broken, and fix it with the team rather than around them.
  • Spot ranking opportunities the brief missed. You read SERPs, not just drafts. If a piece could capture a featured snippet with a structural change, or a related keyword cluster is sitting there unclaimed, you flag it and adjust.
  • Run quality control. You're the last set of eyes before content ships. Clarity, flow, tone, accuracy, brand voice, and the unglamorous stuff like internal links, metadata, and formatting. You'll help formalize our QA process so quality doesn't depend on any one person being in the room.
  • Give writers feedback that makes them better. Direct, specific, actionable notes that explain the strategic reasoning, not just the correction. Our writers are good. Your job is to make them sharper.

Requirements

Where this goes

This role exists because our content department is growing faster than one director can quality-control. The interim coverage is the immediate need. The real opportunity is what comes after.

The person who succeeds here will help build the editorial function itself: the standards, the QA program, the feedback systems that let a team scale without quality slipping. As the department grows, this seat is positioned to grow into a leadership role, including mentoring and eventually managing editors. You'll be learning team leadership directly from the content director, with real responsibility from week one rather than a title and a waiting period.

If you're a senior editor who has hit the ceiling at your current job, this is the next rung.

Who does well in this role

  • 5+ years editing strategic marketing content (SEO content, landing pages, email, PPC assets) in an agency or similar fast-moving environment. You've edited for performance outcomes, not just polish.
  • You can read an SEO strategy document and find its weak points. Keyword selection, intent mapping, funnel logic, content architecture. This is fluency, not familiarity.
  • You work independently by default. During the leave period, you'll be making editorial calls without a director to escalate to. You need the judgment to make those calls and the documentation habits to make them defensible.
  • You're a genuine team player. Independent doesn't mean lone wolf. You'll be collaborating daily with writers, strategists, and PMs, and your feedback style needs to build trust fast.
  • You're direct and kind in the same sentence. Writers should leave your edits better at their jobs, not deflated.
  • You want more responsibility than your current role gives you. You've probably already been doing unofficial leadership work: mentoring writers, building processes nobody asked for, being the person the team actually goes to. You want a seat where that's the job description instead of the extra credit.

Benefits

How the role works

  • Contract engagement to start, with conversion to full-time based on performance during the contract period.
  • Fully remote. We'll need meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time business hours for collaboration.
  • Competitive contract rate commensurate with experience ($3,000-$5,000 a month). Full-time conversion includes salary, benefits, PTO, and professional development budget.

In this role you will be responsible for leading and supporting all aspects of scheduling and EVMS implementations, program support, training, tools, and surveillance functions from proposal to preparation for award, to start-up through IBRs and continuing through the execution lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is recognized as an experienced leader who has expertise in a broad range of functional areas and disciplines, including program management, EVMS implementations and compliance, scheduling, financial disciplines (pricing, program finance, FP&A, etc.), contract management, and strong understanding of inter-company functional relationships. You should be able to lead a team of individual contributors, program finance analysts (PFAs), schedulers, Control Account Managers (CAMs), Program Managers, and line executives. The position provides leadership and hands on support to the program EVMS support teams, CAMs, and Program Managers to improve program planning and execution while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and company policy and procedures. As the principal EVMS implementation SME, the position works closely with program teams, other functions, and line managers to establish, maintain, and grow key government customer relationships and to help drive program growth and execution of the Business Plan.

It is important to note that the Leidos EVMS portfolio has programs across many diverse customer environments (e.g., DoD, FAA, Intel, DHS, Healthcare), contracting scenarios (e.g., integrated subks, formal flow down, reporting only, EVMS on FFP), and across a range of dollar values with different levels of external and internal understanding and buy-in. The ideal candidate will have various experiences across these diverse challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Implementation of EVMS and scheduling policies.

  • Provide improved proposal and implementation support by providing training and objective assessments of implementation adequacy.

  • In coordination with the Director of Surveillance, supports internal and external surveillance, audits and reviews.

  • Development, implementation, training, and maintenance of automated EVMS processes and tools.

  • Utilize prior deep management and leadership knowledge of Program Management and EVMS to lead cross-family projects or program teams or manage across multiple disciplines.

  • Responsible for supporting the organization's EVMS talent development, performance management, and business strategy.

  • Support programs in operational decisions and provide advice on enhancing the performance of the portfolio of projects in the organizations.

  • Aligning and integrating Agile software practices with traditional scheduling and EVMS best practices for improved program management solutions.

  • Utilize expert domain knowledge, professional principles and theories to develop advanced concepts, techniques, solutions and standards.

  • Serves as a subject matter expert within professional area providing a thorough understanding of EVMS, deliverable content, issue identification/resolution, etc.

  • Regularly interacts with senior executive leadership (internally or client) regarding matters of strategic importance to the organization/project.

  • Significant interface with Program Managers, Contracts and Senior Technical Personnel, as well as other organizations.

  • May participate in new business proposals through EVMS requirements, schedule support, and providing input for cost volumes to management.

  • Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of prior relevant experience. Additional years of relevant EVMS experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

raw.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Healthcare is rapidly changing, and our members are living longer, often with more chronic conditions.
raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Healthcare is rapidly changing, and our members are living longer, often with more chronic conditions. Consumers expect more personalized and holistic experiences from their health partners. Humana is committed to innovation to create new approaches and optimize existing assets to improve member experiences and health outcomes through better integrating Humana’s clinical capabilities, processes, and technology. This role will be instrumental in defining and executing on the vision of our transition to being a more health outcomes-oriented organization that also strengthens the financial performance of the business in partnership with leaders and teams across Humana.

The AVP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy is a senior leadership role at the center of this transformation. This leader will design, test, and scale new cross-functional approaches to clinical programs and products that measurably improve the experience, clinical outcomes, and total cost of care for our members. Working at the intersection of clinical strategy, product, and operations, the AVP will translate ambitious clinical priorities into pilots, launch them with rigor, and scale what works across the enterprise.
This is a challenging, highly visible role that demands the ability to navigate ambiguity, align many stakeholders around a shared vision, and deliver results in a complex, matrixed environment. It is also one of the most impactful roles on the team as it directly shapes how Humana improves health outcomes and lowers costs for millions of members.

Our team within Clinical Innovation & Trend employs a rigorous process to set specific clinical priorities for the enterprise, identify the greatest sources of value, and lead a multi-disciplinary process to identify discrete opportunities for enhanced clinical outcomes, cost control, quality, and member experience. The AVP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy will lead a substantial portion of this work as they own the end-to-end journey from clinical strategy through program and product design, implementation, and scaling.


Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities include:

  • Drive enterprise-wide clinical strategy: play a leadership role on a team that develops and executes on enterprise-wide clinical strategies that drive improved health outcomes for our members.
  • Lead clinical program and product design, implementation, and scaling by owning the full lifecycle from concept and pilot design through launch, and then maintaining strategic oversight as programs are scaled to ensure continuous improvement and sustained impact.
  • Clinical program and intervention scope includes near to medium term value delivery of across digital health partnerships strategy and execution, Stars clinical strategy and interventions for key HEDIS measures (GSD / CBP and Care Coordination), and specialty strategy in key high-cost specialties (oncology, CV, MSK, kidney care, etc.).
  • In addition, this leader is responsible for driving the evolution our long-term approach to integrated clinical products to deeply understand member needs and create a differentiated clinical experience and outcomes and cost impact.
  • Lead both the team directly and drive deep collaboration with partner teams across the enterprise, uniting business leaders, clinicians, product managers, analytics, engineering, and design around common goals.
  • Work across the organization in a multidisciplinary way to lead strategic partners across the enterprise, including business leaders, clinicians, and analytics experts, to develop strategies for complex clinical programs.
  • Influence others across the organization to ensure enterprise-wide efforts are coordinated, focused on the highest-value opportunities, and take advantage of synergies that occur when multiple teams with different skillsets and scopes come together for common goals.
  • Design, test, and scale new cross-functional approaches that improve the experience, clinical outcomes, and cost of care for members, building repeatable capabilities and operating models that outlast any single initiative.
  • Provide strategic input, updates, and presentations to enterprise-wide forums.
  • Influence senior decision-makers at Humana on opportunities to improve health, lower costs, and improve experience for members, providers, and associates.
  • Exercise independent judgment and decision making on complex issues and bring others along with them.

Required Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree
  • 10+ years of strategy and operations development and implementation experience for healthcare-related organizations.
  • Clinical operations experience and expertise, including a deep understanding of how care is delivered across payers and providers, and especially the intersection between the two.
  • Product experience managing multidisciplinary teams, including analytics, engineering, design, and clinical roles, to build and scale programs or products.
  • Strong business and/or consulting experience.
  • Solid business and financial acumen.
  • Experience with analytics and use of data.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams to execute on complex projects.
  • Process improvement experience.
  • Ability to influence, establish, and drive improved business outcomes.
  • Ability to lead a diverse group of people toward a common vision with proven results related to motivation, engagement, and goal attainment.

40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience in developing cybersecurity solutions and services, with a focus on IAM/PAM, ICS environments, and network security.

  • Linux system administration & troubleshooting experience.
  • Highly developed, process-oriented skills for troubleshooting, problem solving, and problem resolution.
  • Comfortable with one high-level programming language.
  • Proficient in Shell/Bash/Python/C++Knowledge of virtual machines, network virtualization, and containerization technologies (Docker)
  • Customer focus, understand customer needs and not only what customers say. People skills to gain customers respect and compassion.

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working directly in an industrial environment is a plus.
  • Experience working with automation platform, such as Ansible.
  • Self-motivated and results focused; ability to strengthen the team and its mission.
  • Ability to travel based on the needs of the business. Up to 30%.
  • Comfortable in teaching and coaching technical subjects.

raw.title: Product Manager — Service of Process
raw.excerpt: About ABC Legal ServicesABC Legal Services is proud to be the national leader in service of process.
raw.description:
About ABC Legal ServicesABC Legal Services is proud to be the national leader in service of process. We are a team of 1000 and growing with offices in Los Angeles, Oklahoma City, Phoenix, Brooklyn, Chicago, Washington DC, and more. Seattle is our home and headquarters. We've been successful in this unique business for over 30 years and we continue to advance our technology and business processes to remain years ahead of what our competition is able to offer. Our focus is to expand our technology lead, acquire and integrate less efficient competitors, and tap into new segments through an integrated inbound marketing and sales approach.

Job Overview

ABC Legal is a tech-forward, tech-enabled legal services business — we use technology to power a core operational service, not the other way around. We're hiring a Product Manager to help own one or more of our Service of Process product line: the mobile app process servers use in the field, the customer-facing web portal, the enterprise APIs our largest clients integrate with, and the proprietary platform that powers job assignment, routing, task management, and evidence chain.

Reporting directly to the CTO as a Product Manager, you will own discovery, requirements, cross-functional coordination, launch readiness, and outcome accountability — not backlog grooming and engineering coordination. You'll work directly with process servers, our operations team, enterprise customers, and engineering, Our product team today sits closer to the execution side of product and is strong at delivery, lighter on discovery, market insight, and outcome ownership. Part of your role is to model what upstream product work looks like at ABC.

Why This Job Is Interesting

Every job we run is a physical-world logistics problem — get a real person to a real address, at a time they'll actually be there. Our product has to serve a distributed field workforce, a demanding set of legal customers, an internal operations organization of hundreds, and a court system that has different rules by county.

We're also further into production AI than almost anyone in this industry: dozens of AI agents run live today across service validation, document handling, evidence review, and operational decision support. You'll help decide where that belongs in the product and where it doesn't. Process serving is one of the most analog, paper-bound corners of legal services with county-by-county rules, physical proof of service, workflows that haven't changed in decades. We intend to be the company that rebuilds it around AI first, not the one playing catch-up in five years. You'll help decide what "AI-native" actually means for our business.

Key Responsibilities

Own your product area end to end

  • Own outcomes, not just output, for your area of the Service of Process product line like the APIs and integrations our largest clients build against, and the proprietary platform behind job assignment, routing, task management, and evidence chain, as well as the customer web portal and our field mobile app.
  • Set and defend the priority order. Decide what gets built, what waits, and what we stop doing
  • Maintain a rolling roadmap that survives contact with reality: sequenced, tied to business outcomes, revised openly when the evidence changes.

Run your own discovery

  • Get into the field. Ride along with process servers, sit with the operations teams who work jobs all day, and watch customers use the product.
  • Run structured discovery with customers — interviews, win/loss input, support themes, usage data — and turn it into a written point of view about what to build and why.
  • Serve two distinct user populations: external customers who want speed, price, and certainty, and internal operators whose throughput determines whether we can deliver it.

Turn insight into shipped software

  • Write the requirements: crisp problem statements, success criteria, edge cases, and the operational and legal constraints that apply by jurisdiction
  • Own the backlog for your team(s) within our SAFe cadence: features and stories, acceptance, iteration planning, and PI planning.
  • Work directly and daily with mobile, web, and backend engineering. Break work into releasable increments, unblock decisions fast, and make tradeoff calls
  • Own launch readiness end to end: rollout plan, internal enablement, support readiness, migration and backfill, and a defined rollback path.
  • Own release quality for your area. We have no separate QA team: you decide what needs testing and to what depth, shape the test approach, and coordinate the business owners and operations partners who validate the work in their own domain.
  • Make the go/no-go call, and confirm after release that what shipped does what the requirements said and that the customer and operational outcomes you predicted show up in production.

Partner with Operations as a first-class customer

  • Treat internal operations as a product surface with real users and real cost. Tooling that saves an ops team minutes per job compounds across hundreds of thousands of jobs
  • Find where automation, better routing, or better decision support removes manual work — and quantify what that work is worth before committing to it

Ship AI into the product responsibly

  • ABC runs AI in production today across service validation, evidence review, document handling, and operational decision support. Own where AI belongs in your product area
  • Define the accuracy bar, the human-review path, and the failure behavior for every AI-assisted feature before it ships. Default to advisory; earn the right to automate by clearing a threshold you set in advance.
  • Hold AI features to the same outcome accountability as everything else: measured agreement with the qualified human who would otherwise make the call.

Measure, and be accountable to the measurement

  • Define the success metric for every initiative before it ships, and name the dashboard where it will be watched.
  • Pull your own numbers. You'll have direct access to our analytics environment and reporting to decide what worked and what didn’t and act on it

Manage risk and compliance

  • Understand the regulatory and evidentiary texture of this business: jurisdiction- specific service and filing requirements, chain-of-evidence integrity, proof of service standards, and the handling of sensitive case and party data.
  • Identify compliance and operational risk early and design around it — a product decision that creates a defect in a proof of service is a legal problem, not a bug.
  • Ensure changes clear the appropriate cross-functional review before release.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–7 years of product management experience, including at least one product spanning multiple technical surfaces (e.g. mobile + web, or a field/consumer app backed by a core platform).
  • Demonstrated track record of running your own discovery and turning it into shipped requirements — not just executing a spec you were handed.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineering across mobile, web, and backend teams simultaneously.
  • Hands-on backlog ownership in a scaled agile environment — writing and accepting work, running iteration planning, and participating in quarterly planning. SAFe specifically is a plus; scaled agile of some kind is expected.
  • Experience with B2B APIs, integrations, or platform products — versioning, developer-facing documentation, integration partners, enterprise technical requirements. This is where the role is most likely to center.
  • Comfortable with data. You can pull your own numbers and build your own view rather than waiting on an analyst. SQL is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Evidence that you've raised the product bar around you — introduced a discovery practice, moved a team from output to outcomes, or influenced peers and leaders who don't report to you. This role carries a change mandate, not just a delivery mandate.
  • Experience owning release quality without a dedicated QA team behind you — scoping what to test, running UAT with business stakeholders, and holding people who don't report to you to a testing commitment. If you've only shipped with a QA org catching things downstream of you, this part of the job will be a real adjustment.
  • Some go-to-market experience — comfortable partnering on launch messaging, sales enablement, or customer rollout, not just handing off a shipped feature and moving on.
  • Experience navigating a cross-functional sign-off or impact-review process before release, or a clear point of view on why one matters.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Native mobile product experience (iOS/Android), especially apps used by a field workforce in real working conditions.
  • Experience building for internal operators — where the product's users are colleagues and their throughput is the business.
  • Experience shipping AI-assisted features, and a clear point of view on where automation should and shouldn't replace human judgment.
    • Legal services, legal tech, process serving, litigation support, courts, or another regulated / compliance-heavy industry background. Genuinely a plus, genuinely not required — we'll teach you this domain.

Benefits

We know that a company's success starts with its employees. We also know that an individual's success starts with the right career opportunity. Join our team today!

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Paid time off
  • 7 Paid company holidays
  • 4 Floating holidays per-year
  • Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Long Term Disability
  • Health Care Reimbursement Flexible Spending Account
  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Pet Insurance

Schedule: Full-Time Monday-Friday 8am-5pm
Salary Range: $110,000-$120,000 (depending on experience)
Location: Remote

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.
Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.
Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

Role Description:

We are hiring a Chemicals Procurement Specialist to lead the engagement with specialty chemical and raw material suppliers and to deliver exceptional outcomes for the buyers on Valdera’s procurement platform.
Suppliers play a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect high-quality quotes. Delivering that quality depends on identifying the right suppliers—and on our ability to motivate their active participation on Valdera’s procurement platform. This requires a strong understanding of chemical markets and a proactive approach towards supplier outreach.
You will take ownership of supplier engagement, including the simultaneous management of multiple buyer-initiated Requests for Quotes (RFQs). You’re energized by applying your expertise in chemicals, conducting in-depth supply market assessments, and confidently engaging with suppliers across the globe. As a customer-obsessed professional, you are dedicated to delivering exceptional outcomes for our buyers.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Own and manage a high volume of Request for Quotes (RFQs) for buyers, ensuring timely delivery of multiple high-quality quotes for each requested material
  • Assess supplier landscape to identify and select appropriate suppliers for requested materials
  • Engage with new suppliers to confirm material availability and secure competitive quotes
  • Facilitate communication between suppliers and buyers regarding product specifications, samples and delivery terms
  • Validate the quality and accuracy of quotes and supplier-submitted data
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers already active on the Valdera platform
  • Onboard new suppliers onto the Valdera platform ensuring a smooth and frictionless integration experience
  • Maintain thorough documentation of product availability, supplier communication and sourcing activity

Experience & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in the chemical industry
  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or natural science
  • 5+ years of experience in sourcing, technical sales, business development, partnership, or management consulting
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct supply market assessments and identify suppliers for specific chemicals / raw materials
  • Extensive knowledge of chemicals / raw materials and relevant technical expertise in reviewing RFQs (TDS, SDS, COA, etc.). 
  • Ability to identify alternate or offset materials by reviewing technical documentation and product chemistry.
  • Experience in establishing and managing strong supplier relationships
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build trust and rapport with suppliers
  • Capable of creating structured plans, tracking steps, and managing multiple priorities effectively

Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s individual skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera.

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Hard skills

  • Familiarity with reporting tools such as Looker;
  • API knowledge, using Postman, SOAPui and Webhooks;

  • Comfortable with SQL;
  • Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, Hubspot, Zoho, etc.

Preferred experience

  • You are familiar with working in remote or hybrid environments;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Previous experience in a client-facing technical role for a SaaS or telecom business;

  • Comfortable multitasking in a fast-paced environment;

About Xage

Xage is the first and only zero trust real-world security company. Powered by the Xage Fabric, the company’s Identity & Access Management, remote access, and dynamic data security solutions allow customers to secure, manage, and transform operations. With its distributed, scalable, and easy-to-operate Fabric, Xage solves the complex digitization challenges of the real-world operations we rely on. Xage customers include leaders in manufacturing, energy, O&G, utilities, space, logistics, and transportation.
Xage is looking for a Solutions Engineer to lead our technical interests with customers and partners. The responsibility of this role is to work with customers and partners to design winning solutions as part of the pre-sales cycle, enabling Xage to accelerate customer acquisition and achieve sales goals

About the Role

  • Work creatively with customer and internal stakeholders to define technical solutions that meet customer use cases and requirements using a combination of internal and in some cases 3rd party software/hardware/tools.
  • Create and present detailed technical and business proposals demonstrating how Xage addresses customer challenges, including solution architecture, use case description, and deployment schedules.
  • Represent Xage at industry events and conferences, including occasional speaking engagements.
  • Identify gaps in product functionality and flexibility and proactively work with product management and engineering organizations to address these gaps using a combination of internal R&D and technology/product partnerships.

About You

  • Demonstrated hands-on technical knowledge and experience working with industrial networking solutions, industrial control systems, or cybersecurity solutions (e.g., identity and access management).
  • Demonstrated success in creating winning solutions and proposals that result in customer wins and exceeded sales goals.
  • Demonstrated success forming technology solutions and system integration partnerships in industrial verticals.
  • Experience and understanding of the operational requirements of utility companies, oil & gas operators, renewable energy operators, and/or transportation operations.
  • Experience with product or service delivery with Identity and Access Management solutions.
  • Deep understanding of IT and OT network communication protocols.
  • Knowledge and understanding of various security control frameworks (e.g., IEC62443, NERC CIP, NIST, NCSC CAF).
  • Knowledge of Purdue Reference Architecture.
  • Experience with the application of threat modeling or other risk identification techniques.
  • Knowledge and experience in cybersecurity assessments for both OT & IT security.
  • Good understanding of Operational Technologies such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) software, RTUs, HMI, and Distributed Control Systems (DCS).
  • Strong experience with Windows, Active Directory, LDAP with knowledge of UNIX/Linux systems.
  • Ability to communicate & present to a range of technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent architecture life-cycle design and documentation skills.

Complementary Skills

  • Expertise in network segmentation and micro-segmentation.
  • Proficiency in designing secure network architectures integrating IT and OT environments.
  • In-depth knowledge of securing industrial protocols.
  • Advanced skills in implementing RBAC and ABAC.
  • Experience with secure remote access solutions for industrial environments.
  • Expertise in hardening network devices.
  • Proficiency in implementing data encryption and secure communications.
  • Skills in integrating IAM solutions with network security tools.
  • Experience in designing scalable network solutions.
  • Knowledge of security automation and orchestration tools

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor of Science or higher in Engineering or another technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience with networking, industrial automation, or security solutions, with at least 5 years of experience working in or with field sales organizations. Senior roles in technical field roles preferred.
  • Minimum 3+ years of work experience in Operational Technology Security.
  • Strong experience in technical pre-sales support of cybersecurity solutions for industrial operations/critical infrastructure.
  • Able to respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Conduct and ensure success of customer proof-of-concepts (POCs).
  • Strong presentation skills as well as the ability to build and present high-quality product demonstrations to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills; ability to build relationships at multiple levels to work cross-organizationally toward solutions; excellent leadership and consensus-building skills.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts focused on access management in OT landscapes to meet functional, technical, and regulatory requirements.
  • Prior experience with enterprise applications, security management, systems management, identity management, and/or policy management solutions preferred, especially in the IAM or remote access space.
  • GICSP, CISSP, or SANS certification preferred.

raw.title: Sr. Data Scientist II (Remote Eligible)
raw.excerpt: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter.
raw.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist II to build the ML models and AI sub-agents that drive growth, monetization, efficiency, and retention across the customer lifecycle. You’ll work end-to-end framing problems, building models across the modern ML and deep learning toolkit, designing sub-agents that reason and act, and shipping all of it into production for millions of users. The data is unusually rich: petabyte-scale execution data spanning two decades of how real work gets done. You are curious, technically rigorous, and can translate complex modeling and sub-agent behavior into clear recommendations for your partners. You will work primarily with Product and Engineering and will be a part of Smartsheet’s Business Intelligence team.

This full-time position initially reports to the VP of Data Science located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

  • Design and ship AI sub-agents that act across the customer lifecycle, combining predictive models, retrieved context, and LLM reasoning to recommend or take action
  • Build the predictive and prescriptive models that power those sub-agents churn risk, growth, adoption trajectories, account health scoring, and similar lifecycle problems
  • Develop the data foundations and knowledge layer those sub-agents reason over, applying responsible aggregation and privacy-aware design
  • Design the tools, retrieval, and grounding strategies each sub-agent uses; decide when a sub-agent should act, recommend, defer, or escalate
  • Build the evaluation harnesses that determine when a sub-agent is good enough to ship and that catch regressions in production
  • Define metrics and experimentation strategy for sub-agent rollouts; measure real customer impact, not just offline accuracy or eval scores
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Applied AI teams from problem framing through production deployment
  • Drive a data and modeling culture within Product and Engineering, and mentor other data scientists on the team

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience (or 10+ years of experience); advanced degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, CS, ML, Economics, Operations Research, or similar) preferred
  • Deep applied ML expertise across both traditional ML and deep learning: gradient boosting, regularized linear models, transformer-based sequence models, foundation model embeddings, causal ML, contextual bandits, and offline RL
  • Strong grasp of causal inference for intervention design and lifecycle modeling: uplift modeling, difference-in-differences, propensity scoring, and synthetic control
  • Solid foundation in statistics and experimental design: hypothesis testing, power analysis, multiple comparisons, sequential testing, and quasi-experimental methods
  • Hands-on experience taking LLM- and agent-based systems to production: tool use, retrieval, multi-step reasoning, evaluation, and guardrails
  • Experience operating ML in production — feature engineering and pipelines, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining cadence, and the trade-offs between batch and real-time serving
  • Proficient in SQL and Python; comfort with ML/LLM tooling at scale (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), ML frameworks (PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM), and visualization tools (Tableau or similar)
  • Experience modeling the customer lifecycle — churn, expansion, adoption, plan health, lead/account scoring — and business fluency in the SaaS metrics that drive it (NRR, GRR, ARR, and cohort economics)
  • A pragmatic production bar: latency, cost, monitoring, drift, hallucination, and what happens when the model or sub-agent is wrong
  • Strong track record of forming effective cross-functional partnerships and communicating analysis clearly to technical and executive audiences
  • Ability to research and learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies, and to thrive in a dynamic environment — finding opportunities and executing in both independent and collaborative environments

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
