raw.description:
The Client Success Manager (CSM) serves as the primary day-to-day contact and relationship owner for clients, leading cross-functional campaign delivery across multiple media channels. Acting as a trusted strategic partner, the CSM connects campaign execution to client business objectives, ensures clear communication and accountability, and helps identify opportunities to strengthen and grow the client relationship.

The main objective of this role is to drive client success and account growth through proactive communication, critical thinking, internal leadership, and seamless cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate is both detail-oriented and big-picture minded, able to translate client objectives into outcome-focused media strategies, navigate ambiguity, and foster long-term client trust and satisfaction.

Primary Accountabilities:

Client Leadership and Relationship Management (70%):

  • Serve as the primary client contact, maintaining consistent communication, ensuring clarity of deliverables, and proactively managing expectations.

  • Partner closely with clients to understand their business objectives and translate them into outcome-focused media strategies aligned to goals such as incremental sales, return on ad spend, foot traffic, awareness, consideration, and other agreed measures of success.

  • Demonstrate strong critical thinking by identifying challenges, proposing solutions, and connecting campaign activity to the client's broader business objectives.

  • Lead client status meetings, campaign reviews, and performance discussions, coordinating the participation of Analytics, Ad Operations, and other subject matter experts as appropriate.

  • Develop and present client-facing materials including campaign recaps, performance reports, and strategic recommendations; partner with Analytics subject matter experts on measurement interpretation and client-facing measurement presentations.

  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Ad Operations, Creative, Creator Solutions, Analytics, Sales, and other partners to ensure high-quality execution, clear ownership, and continuous improvement.

  • Act as a client advocate internally, ensuring the team delivers high-quality work that meets or exceeds client expectations.

  • Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional solutions, and future investment by uncovering evolving client needs and business objectives.

  • Partner with Sales on renewals, upsell opportunities, and account growth strategies while maintaining continuity across the client relationship.

    Build trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders and contribute to long-term retention and growth through consultative guidance.

Campaign Strategy and Operational Excellence (30%):

  • Oversee campaign planning and activation to ensure timelines, deliverables, and performance expectations are achieved; partner with Ad Operations as the owner of tactical optimization and communicate recommendations and tradeoffs to clients.

  • Maintain a working understanding of campaign performance and measurement so that recommendations from Analytics and Ad Operations can be translated into clear, client-relevant implications and next steps.

  • Manage internal project workflows via Monday.com, Salesforce, and other systems to maintain visibility into campaign progress.

  • Conduct quality checks on deliverables, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to client and brand standards.

  • Anticipate potential issues or delays, problem-solve proactively, and lead internal and external communication through resolution while maintaining client confidence.

  • Support the integration of influencer, retail media, and paid social components within broader omnichannel strategies and execution.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of evolving media trends, ensuring strategies remain current and competitive.

  • Lead internal kickoff meetings and cross-functional working sessions, drive accountability to commitments, facilitate difficult conversations, and build alignment without direct authority.

  • Leverage approved AI-enabled tools and automation to improve campaign planning, client communications, reporting workflows, operational efficiency, and the quality of strategic recommendations.

  • Continuously identify process improvements that reduce manual effort, improve visibility, and strengthen the client experience.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in advertising, marketing, communications or similar field

  • 3–5 years of experience in media account management, client service, or marketing.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple clients and campaigns simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and strategic focus.

  • Deep understanding of digital media channels, including paid social, retail media, influencer, and loyalty programs.

  • Skilled in problem-solving and critical thinking with a proactive, solution-oriented approach and a positive mindset.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated confidence in client presentations.

  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Monday.com, Salesforce, and analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Tableau, experience in The Trade Desk is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without authority, and maintain accountability across complex client engagements.

  • Commercial mindset with the ability to recognize client needs, identify growth opportunities, and partner with Sales on account expansion and retention.

  • Comfort using approved AI and automation tools to improve productivity, communication, analysis, and workflow efficiency.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based or global clients within an agency or marketing organization.

  • Familiarity with end-to-end campaign workflows across media and influencer programs.

  • Foundational understanding of campaign analytics, measurement, and optimization strategies, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Analytics and Ad Operations subject matter experts.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

Individual Competencies:

  • Teamwork: Builds relationships and works cooperatively with others, inside and outside the organization, to accomplish objectives to build and maintain mutually-beneficial partnerships, leverage information and achieve results.

  • Adaptable: Responds to change with a willingness to learn new ways to accomplish work objectives with a positive attitude.

  • Curious: A desire to inquire and learn, to seek new knowledge and wisdom, and to listen to the contributions of others with a genuine interest to better self, the team, and the organization.

  • Problem Solving: Gathers and analyzes information to generate and evaluate potential solutions to problems, issues and challenges while weighing the accuracy and relevance of the facts, data and information.

  • Collaboration: Works collaboratively with others to achieve group goals and objectives.

  • Communication: Giving and receiving messages and information in written, oral, and visual formats in a clear and concise way for a complete understanding of meaning and intent.

  • Leadership: Creates clarity, drives alignment, influences without direct authority, and holds self and others accountable for commitments and client outcomes.

As an Inmar Associate, you:

  • Put clients first and consistently display a positive attitude and behaviors that demonstrate an awareness and willingness to listen and respond to clients in order to meet their short-term and long-term needs, requirements and exceed their expectations.

  • Treat clients and teammates with courtesy, consideration and tact; you also have the ability to perceive the needs of internal and external clients and communicate effectively with the objective of delighting and retaining the client.

  • Build collaborative relationships and work cooperatively with others, inside and outside the organization, to accomplish objectives, develop and maintain mutually-beneficial partnerships, leverage information and achieve results.

  • Set and attain achievable, yet aggressive, goals with a sense of urgency and accountability.

  • Understand that results are important and focus on turning mission into action to achieve results following the principles of Agile Execution while consistently complying with quality, service and productivity standards to meet deadlines and exceed expectations by giving our clients the best possible outcome.

***ONLY CURRENTLY REVIEWING APPLICATIONS FROM LATIN AMERICA***

About Tried and True Media (TNT Media)

Tried and True Media is a performance marketing agency that specializes in direct response advertising. Our team is responsible for producing, optimizing, and scaling high-converting ad creatives that drive measurable revenue for our clients. We work with DTC brands, startups, and industry leaders, helping them become household names through creative storytelling and data-driven strategies.

We are looking for highly skilled Freelance Video Editors to join our creative team and help produce engaging, fast-paced, and conversion-focused video ads for digital platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and beyond.

Role Overview

As a Freelance Video Editor, you will be responsible for editing and optimizing ad creatives to maximize performance across various digital platforms. Your role will involve cutting, color-correcting, adding motion graphics, sound design, and creating engaging visual effects that capture audience attention within the first few seconds. You will work closely with our Creative Producers, Copywriters, and Media Buyers to iterate on concepts based on performance data and audience engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit engaging video ads that drive conversions and maximize user engagement.
  • Cut and assemble raw footage into polished, high-performing creatives.
  • Incorporate motion graphics, text overlays, and subtitles for social media formats.
  • Optimize pacing, transitions, and storytelling to match performance trends.
  • Enhance audio and sound design to create a dynamic user experience.
  • Repurpose existing content into different aspect ratios and formats for A/B testing.
  • Stay up to date with social media trends to ensure creatives remain fresh and competitive.
  • Collaborate with our creative team to continuously refine ad creatives based on data-driven insights.
  • Available 9am - 6pm EST

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing, direct response advertising, or social media content creation.

  • English Proficiency (Written and spoken)

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator are a plus).

  • Understanding of digital advertising best practices, including video pacing, hook optimization, and engagement techniques.

  • Experience editing short-form content for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Ads.

  • Strong grasp of audio editing and sound design to enhance storytelling.

  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and quickly iterate based on feedback.

  • Attention to detail, strong storytelling instincts, and a knack for viral content trends.

  • Bonus: Experience with AI-powered editing tools, 3D animation, or motion tracking.

Technical Requirements

Editing equipment is not provided. Applicants are expected to meet the following minimum requirements:

  • Operating System:

    • Windows: Windows 11 (64-bit)

    • macOS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later

  • Processor (CPU):

    • Intel: Intel® 6th Gen or newer

    • Apple: M1/M2/M3+ series (Apple Silicon is optimized for Adobe software)

  • RAM:

    • 12GB RAM

  • GPU (Graphics Card):

    • NVIDIA RTX 3060 / 3070 / 4060 / 4070 / 4080 / 4090

    • AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 XT or better

    • Apple M1/M2/M3 Pro/Max chips work well

  • Storage:

    • 50GB Free Space

  • Monitor Resolution:

    • 1920 x 1080

  • ADOBE CREATIVE CLOUD ACCESS:

    • **Adobe Licenses are not provided. Please be sure to have access to v2025 Premiere / After Effects / Media Encoder

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly freelance rates (paid monthly).

  • Transparent booking requests

  • Flexible, remote work (no obligation to accept booking requests)

  • Ongoing work opportunities with a fast-growing agency.

  • Data-driven feedback to help you refine and improve your editing style.

  • A team of creative professionals dedicated to producing top-tier ad creatives.

What to Expect in the Hiring Process

Our selection process is designed to ensure a great fit for both you and our team. Here’s what it involves:

  • Application Submission – Complete the form and provide your details.

    • Portfolio Review – Share your best work that highlights your skills.

  • Live Interview – Join a camera-on remote interview with our managing team.

We appreciate your time and effort throughout the process and look forward to reviewing your application!

This role sits within a lean, fast-moving marketing team and reports to the Director of Marketing. You’ll collaborate closely with our sales, media, events, and content teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the lifecycle email program end to end, including strategy, journey architecture, copy, execution, reporting, and optimization.

  • Map and optimize the buyer journey that turns managing partners and legal executives into clients.

  • Build multi-stage nurture flows, webinar invitation sequences, case study campaigns, and re-engagement programs in HubSpot for long, high-consideration sales cycles.

  • Write direct-response copy tailored to different legal audiences and practice areas, including emails, subject lines, offers, and landing pages.

  • Own email deliverability and domain reputation, including authentication, subdomain strategy, list hygiene, sender reputation, and inbox placement at firms with strict IT filtering.

  • Develop and manage a continuous A/B testing roadmap across messaging, offers, subject lines, audience segments, and send strategies.

  • Report on performance against qualified meetings, SQLs, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity.

  • Partner with sales and marketing stakeholders to improve lead follow-up, campaign coordination, and lifecycle performance.

  • A portfolio of direct-response email copy that you personally wrote and can discuss in detail.

  • 3+ years of experience building and managing email marketing and automation programs, preferably in B2B or another high-consideration sales environment.

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable enterprise marketing automation platform, including building workflows yourself.

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, including authentication, list hygiene, sender reputation, inbox placement, and CAN-SPAM compliance.

  • Fluency in audience segmentation, behavioral triggers, nurture strategy, and A/B testing.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect email performance to qualified opportunities and pipeline.

  • Excellent written English and strong overlap with US business hours.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing legal services or another high-value service with a long, considered sales cycle.

  • An understanding of how personal injury firms make money, including cost per signed case, intake conversion, and referral relationships.

  • Experience with DealFront, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign in addition to HubSpot.

  • Experience incorporating LinkedIn automation or SMS into coordinated lifecycle campaigns.

  • Experience using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow.

Benefits

  • Starting Salary of $95,000

  • Fully Remote

  • Unlimited PTO

  • $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program

  • Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Human Resume Review: Your resume will be reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. Video Questionnaire: Selected candidates will be sent a link to complete 5 questions through video. Please plan to record in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

  3. Live Zoom Interview:Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Managers for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.

  4. Skills Assessment: A short email writing and campaign logic exercise. Plan for 60 to 90 minutes. Use AI however you normally would, as long as you can explain your choices.

  5. Final Interview:Finalists will meet with members of the marketing leadership team to review their assessment, discuss how they approach lifecycle strategy and collaboration, and ensure mutual alignment before a final decision.

In solchen Fällen bist Du bei uns für unsere Kunden im Notfall als Kundenbetreuer erster Ansprechpartner.
Es handelt sich dabei um einen Job ohne Verkaufstätigkeiten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der telefonischen Aufnahme und Lösung von Kundenanliegen, die im Zusammenhang mit einer Kfz-, Haus- oder Familienversicherung entstehen
  • Organisation und Koordination erster Hilfsmaßnahmen für unsere internationalen Kunden, wie z. B. Pannen-, Unfall- und Abschlepphilfe, sowie bei Bedarf weitere Dienstleistungen wie Hotelbuchungen, Mietwagen oder Ähnliches
  • Verantwortung für die E-Mail- sowie Telefonkorrespondenz mit Versicherungen, Dienstleistern und Partnern zur Klärung und Abwicklung von Sachverhalten inklusive der Rechnungsbearbeitung

das bringst du mit

  • Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrungen in der telefonischen Kundenbetreuung im Versicherungsbereich sowie der Rechnungsbearbeitung / Schadensregulierung
  • Für die Einarbeitung, Probezeitendgespräche und Teamevents bist Du bereit, einige Male nach Rostock zu reisen (Übernachtungs- und Reisekostenwerden unsererseits erstattet)
  • Gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse sowie fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse
  • Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Kundenverständnis und handelst lösungsorientiert
  • Du bist ein echter Macher und hast den Antrieb, Dinge in die Hand zu nehmen und voranzutreiben
  • Neuen Kommunikations- und Arbeitstechnologien stehst Du offen gegenüber
  • Du bist ein ausgesprochenes Kommunikationstalent und zuverlässiger Teamplayer mit einer sorgfältigen Arbeitsweise
Vorerst ist die Tätigkeit auf zwei Jahre befristet und nur innerhalb Deutschlands zu besetzen (keine Tätigkeit aus dem Ausland).
Unser Unternehmen wächst stark und bietet ausgezeichnete Chancen auf eine unbefristete Stelle.
Wenn Du zudem über Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft verfügst, auf Basis einer 5-Tage-Woche im Schichtdienst (24/7, Nachtschichten sowie Wochenenden und Feiertage) zu arbeiten, möchten wir Dich gerne kennenlernen.
Deine Wünsche fließen in eine ausgewogene Schichtplanung mit ein. Für Deine Tätigkeit nach 20 Uhr sowie an Sonn- und Feiertagen erhältst Du lukrative steuer- und sozialabgabenfreie Schichtzulagen.
Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionAtRankings. io, we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services.
raw.description:
Description

AtRankings.io, we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services. We are looking for a Law Firm Digital Strategist to connect client objectives to clear priorities,measurable roadmaps, and coordinated work across channels. This role reports to the Chief Strategy Officer and contributes to improving our approach to client strategy.

The Account Manager owns the client relationship and ongoing communication. The Law Firm Digital Strategist owns strategic direction, the roadmap, and the analysis that informs recommendations. Channel teams own execution. This is an individual-contributor role focused on planning, analysis, and direction, without hands-on campaign management or production responsibilities. The Strategist leads strategic discussions within client meetings in partnership with the Account Manager, explains recommendations and results, and participates in occasional in-person meetings.

Responsibilities

Client Objective Translation and Roadmap Ownership

  • Assess each client’s market, competitive position, desired case mix, geographic priorities, and budget to identify opportunities and constraints.

  • Partner with the Account Manager and client to establish realistic growth objectives, accounting for intake performance, firm capacity, and the time required to produce results.

  • Translate objectives into measurable roadmaps covering at least three months, with priorities, milestones, KPIs, and a clear rationale for the recommended approach.

  • Maintain an active roadmap for every assigned client, preparing the next segment before the current one ends. Develop longer-term plans when client goals or complexity require them.

Cross-Channel Strategy and Prioritization

  • Evaluate opportunities across GEO, SEO, Local SEO, paid media, video, organic social, content, link building, CRO, creative, web, and analytics.

  • Establish priorities based on expected impact, dependencies, available resources, and approved client scope and budget. Identify when additional investment or approval is needed.

  • Partner with channel experts to ensure execution plans support the roadmap while allowing specialists to determine the best technical approach.

  • Identify blockers and sequencing issues, challenge work that does not support client objectives, and recommend a better use of resources.

Performance Analysis and Accountability

  • Interpret client performance using qualified lead volume, lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates,signed cases where available, and relevant channel metrics.

  • Diagnose underperformance, distinguish marketing issues from tracking gaps or intake challenges, and develop corrective recommendations with the appropriate teams.

  • Identify when to expand successful initiatives, shift budget or effort, pursue new growth opportunities, or change the approach.

  • Escalate material risks, execution blockers, data issues, and resource constraints promptly, and follow through on agreed actions.

Internal Collaboration and Client-Facing Support

  • Partner closely with Account Managers to align strategic recommendations with client priorities, expectations, and commitments.

  • Lead strategic discussions with clients, explaining performance findings, recommendations, trade offs, and expected outcomes.

  • Keep Account Managers, channel teams, and leadership aligned on priorities and decisions, resolving strategic disagreements constructively.

Roadmap Management and Strategic Documentation

  • Complete monthly strategy checkpoints to evaluate progress, performance trends, blockers, and necessary adjustments.

  • Document objectives, strategic diagnosis, priorities, timelines, KPIs, risks, and next decisions, maintaining clear records of changes and assumptions.

  • Adapt planning depth to each client’s needs, balancing ongoing improvements for successful accounts with deeper analysis for complex or underperforming accounts.

  • Contribute to improving planning processes, templates, and strategy standards as the function evolves.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of digital marketing experience, including responsibility for developing client strategies, evaluating performance, and recommending priorities across multiple channels.

  • Strong understanding across multiple disciplines: SEO and Local SEO, with the ability to evaluate how GEO, paid search, paid social, CRO, content, and video contribute to a shared objective. Deep expertise in every channel is not required.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect multiple channels into a practical plan, explain investment tradeoffs, and adjust priorities based on results.

  • Ability to assess a client’s market, competitive position, business goals, budget, and constraints before recommending an approach.

  • Strong analytical skills, including experience interpreting data from GA4, Google Search Console,

  • advertising platforms, call tracking, CRM systems, SEO tools, or comparable reporting environments.

  • Experience presenting strategies and performance recommendations directly to clients, including

  • navigating difficult conversations.

  • Ability to influence priorities and resolve disagreements constructively with Account Managers, channel specialists, and department leaders.

  • Strong written communication and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize strategic attention across a substantial client portfolio.

  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client strategies is preferred. Legal marketing experience is a plus but is not required.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Client outcomes: Progress toward agreed objectives, including qualified leads, acquisition efficiency, and signed cases where reliable data is available. Outcomes are evaluated in the context of approved budgets,execution, intake performance, and client decisions.

  • Strategic effectiveness:Clear diagnosis, justified priorities, realistic sequencing, and a measurable connection between recommended work and client objectives.

  • Planning and follow-through:Active roadmaps for all assigned clients, completed monthly checkpoints, timely identification of risks, and consistent follow-through on corrective actions.

  • Channel progress:Relevant indicators selected for each client’s objectives, such as organic lead growth, local visibility, paid-media efficiency, conversion rate, impression share, and AI visibility.

Benefits

  • Annual Salary of $100k

  • Fully Remote

  • Unlimited PTO

  • $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program

  • Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Resume Review: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. One Way Interview: Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

  3. Live Zoom Interview:Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Manager for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.
